Fees.Close Fees: Fee charged when a position closes, fully, partially or through its take profit / stop loss.
Fees.Borrow Fees: Hourly borrow on the position size, paid when it closes.

Revenue.Trading Fees To Protocol: The protocol's share of open and close fees, sent to the FeeVault.

ProtocolRevenue.Trading Fees To Protocol: The protocol's share of open and close fees, sent to the FeeVault.

SupplySideRevenue.Trading Fees To Market Creators: The market creator's share of open and close fees.
SupplySideRevenue.Trading Fees To LP Vaults: The rest of the open and close fees, kept by the market's LP vault.
SupplySideRevenue.Borrow Fees To LP Vaults: Borrow, kept by the market's LP vault.

methodology.Volume: SOL paid by buyers and SOL paid out to sellers on the bonding curves, before fees.
methodology.Fees: Everything charged on the launchpad: DEEP's fee on each bonding-curve buy and sell (1.25%), the reward fee a token's creator chose at launch (0% to 5% of each trade), the fee to launch a token ($2, paid in SOL) and the migration fee taken from the SOL a curve raised when its token graduates (1%, less the network rent of the new pool's accounts).
methodology.Revenue: DEEP's share: its 1.25% fee on bonding-curve trades, the token launch fees and the migration fees. Reward fees are not included.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: DEEP's 1.25% fee on bonding-curve trades, the token launch fees and the migration fees, all paid into DEEP's on-chain fee vault, which pays 10% to the team that builds DEEP and 90% to the DEEP treasury.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The reward fee of each token, paid in full to the token's creator or, for a Holder Rewards token, to the holders of that token.

Fees.Bonding Curve Trading Fees: DEEP's fee on each bonding-curve buy and sell (1.25%).
Fees.Bonding Curve Creator Rewards: The reward fee of Creator Rewards tokens (a rate the creator chose at launch, up to 5% of each trade).
Fees.Bonding Curve Holder Rewards: The reward fee of Holder Rewards tokens (a rate the creator chose at launch, up to 5% of each trade).
Fees.Token Launch Fees: The fee to launch a token ($2, paid in SOL at the Pyth SOL/USD price).
Fees.Migration Fees: The part of the SOL a curve raised that DEEP keeps when the token graduates to DeepSwap (1%, less the network rent of the new pool's accounts).

Revenue.Bonding Curve Trading Fees: DEEP's fee on each bonding-curve buy and sell (1.25%).
Revenue.Token Launch Fees: The fee to launch a token.
Revenue.Migration Fees: The migration fee DEEP keeps when a token graduates.

ProtocolRevenue.Bonding Curve Trading Fees: DEEP's fee on each bonding-curve buy and sell (1.25%), paid into DEEP's fee vault.
ProtocolRevenue.Token Launch Fees: The fee to launch a token, paid into DEEP's fee vault.
ProtocolRevenue.Migration Fees: The migration fee DEEP keeps when a token graduates, paid into DEEP's fee vault.

SupplySideRevenue.Bonding Curve Creator Rewards: Reward fees paid to the creators of Creator Rewards tokens.
SupplySideRevenue.Bonding Curve Holder Rewards: Reward fees paid to the holders of Holder Rewards tokens.

methodology.Fees: Everything charged on DeepSwap: the swap fee (0.35% of a buy and 0.75% of a sell), the reward fee the pool charges on top of it (0% to 5%, fixed when the pool was created) and the flat fee in SOL to open a pool. Pools of graduated launchpad tokens are opened by the launchpad, which pays that fee out of the token's migration fee; it is reported with the launchpad, not here.
methodology.Revenue: DEEP's share of the swap fee (0.25% of a buy, 0.65% of a sell) and the pool creation fees.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: DEEP's share of the swap fee (0.25% of a buy, 0.65% of a sell) and the pool creation fees, all paid into DEEP's on-chain fee vault, which pays 10% to the team that builds DEEP and 90% to the DEEP treasury.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Money going to governance token holders
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The liquidity providers' share of the swap fee (0.10% of each swap, left in the pool) and each pool's reward fee, paid in full to the pool's creator or, on a Holder Rewards pool, to the holders of the pool's token.
methodology.Volume: The quote-token side (SOL on a TOKEN/SOL pool) of every swap, before fees.

Fees.Protocol Fees: DEEP's share of the swap fee (0.25% of a buy, 0.65% of a sell).
Fees.LP Fees: The liquidity providers' share of the swap fee (0.10% of each swap).
Fees.Creator Rewards: The reward fee of Creator Rewards pools (a rate fixed when the pool was created, up to 5% of each swap).
Fees.Holder Rewards: The reward fee of Holder Rewards pools (a rate fixed when the pool was created, up to 5% of each swap).
Fees.Pool Creation Fees: The flat fee in SOL to open a pool, except pools opened by the DEEP launchpad for graduated tokens.

Revenue.Protocol Fees: DEEP's share of the swap fee (0.25% of a buy, 0.65% of a sell).
Revenue.Pool Creation Fees: The flat fee in SOL to open a pool.

ProtocolRevenue.Protocol Fees: DEEP's share of the swap fee, paid into DEEP's fee vault.
ProtocolRevenue.Pool Creation Fees: The flat fee in SOL to open a pool, paid into DEEP's fee vault.

SupplySideRevenue.LP Fees: The liquidity providers' share of the swap fee, left in the pool.
SupplySideRevenue.Creator Rewards: Reward fees paid to the creators of Creator Rewards pools.
SupplySideRevenue.Holder Rewards: Reward fees paid to the holders of the token of Holder Rewards pools.

methodology.Fees: Swap fees paid by users
methodology.Revenue: Percentage of swap fees going to treasury and/or token holders
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Percentage of swap fees going to treasury
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Money going to governance token holders
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Liquidity providers revenue

methodology.Fees: Swap fees paid by users
methodology.Revenue: Percentage of swap fees going to treasury and/or token holders
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Percentage of swap fees going to treasury
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Money going to governance token holders
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Liquidity providers revenue

methodology.Fees: QUOTUM trading tax collected by TaxSink, measured in NVDA when claimed, excluding Pons platform fees and direct funding transfers.
methodology.Revenue: Claimed QUOTUM trading tax less the NVDA forwarded to pay inference providers; NVDA forwarded to fund the protocol's own trading agent stays in revenue.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: The fixed 40% share of claimed QUOTUM trading tax transferred to the protocol recipient in NVDA.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Successful buyback NVDA is booked only in hours with burns, capped at positive revenue from UTC midnight through that hour, after subtracting earlier holders bookings that day. No holders revenue is booked when that budget is zero or negative. Excess reserve-funded spending, failed purchases and direct token burns are excluded.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: NVDA forwarded from TaxSink to pay inference providers, excluding the portion the team reports moving on to fund the protocol's trading agent.

Fees.QUOTUM Trading Tax: Gross NVDA collected in TaxSink claims before the fixed 40% protocol share is transferred.

Revenue.QUOTUM Trading Tax: Gross claimed NVDA trading tax less NVDA forwarded to pay inference providers.

ProtocolRevenue.Trading Tax To Protocol: The fixed 40% share of claimed trading tax transferred to the protocol recipient.

HoldersRevenue.Token Buy Back: Successful QUOTUM buyback spend in each burn hour, limited to revenue from UTC midnight through that hour, less holders revenue already booked that day. Reserve-funded excess is excluded.

SupplySideRevenue.Inference Provider Payments: NVDA forwarded to pay for inference, net of the trading-agent funding in the team's published per-session records; a forward counts in full until its record is published.

methodology.Volume: Notional volume of Hyperliquid perpetual trades (including HIP-3 markets) placed through Kokoah, counted from its builder code.
methodology.Fees: Hyperliquid builder code fees paid by users on perpetual trades placed through Kokoah; excludes Hyperliquid's own trading fees.
methodology.Revenue: All builder code fees collected by Kokoah.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: None, all builder code fees go to buying back and burning the Kokoah subnet token.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: All builder code fees go to buying back and burning the token of Kokoah's Bittensor subnet (subnet 39); each burn is published with its transaction at kokoah.com/subnet/buybacks.

Fees.Hyperliquid Builder Code Fees: Builder code fees paid by users on Hyperliquid trades.

Revenue.Hyperliquid Builder Code Fees: Builder code fees collected by the builder.

HoldersRevenue.Hyperliquid Builder Code Fees: Builder code fees distributed to the protocol's token holders.

methodology.Fees: The protocol's fee on the gross premium of each option the vaults sell (20% at launch). v1 vault (NVDA Printer): fixed at the sale and recognized one hour later when the Safe can no longer void the sale; a voided sale charges no fee; a call sold outside the desk (not possible with the current operator) counts the fee the operator reports at settlement. v2 and v2.1 funds (Robinhood Chain and BNB Chain): the premium stays escrowed in the fund until the epoch settles, so the fee is counted at settlement, as the fund reports it (EpochSettled.fee); voided positions and unpriced settlements charge none. The premium itself is not counted as fees: it is the buyer's payment for the option, which depositors carry against the risk of the option settling in the money (see the options adapter's premium volume).
methodology.Revenue: All of the fee on the gross premium of each option the vaults sell, credited to the HedgeHood treasury Safe at settlement.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: All of the fee on the gross premium of each option the vaults sell, credited to the HedgeHood treasury Safe at settlement.

Fees.Desk fee on option premiums: v1: desk fee fixed at each sale (QuotedLocked.fee), zero if the sale was voided (QuotedVoided); for a call sold outside the desk, the fee recorded at settlement (getEpoch.feePaid). v2 / v2.1: the fee each fund books when an epoch settles (EpochSettled.fee), in USDG on Robinhood Chain and USDT on BNB Chain.

Revenue.Desk fee on option premiums: The same fee, credited to the HedgeHood treasury Safe.

ProtocolRevenue.Desk fee on option premiums: The same fee, credited to the HedgeHood treasury Safe.

methodology.Fees: Trading fees paid on sprout.fun bonding curves (1% or 3% per launch) and in the Choice v2 pools that launches graduate into (same rate, taken by the Sprout hook).
methodology.Revenue: Trading fees minus the share credited to launch creators and referrers (the platform share).
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Share of trading fees credited to launch creators, and on the curve to referrers.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Part of the platform share that is not used for SPROUT buyback and burn.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: 80% of the platform share funds SPROUT buyback and burn (ratio taken from the Sprout docs).

Fees.Bonding Curve Trading Fees: Fees charged on every buy and sell on the bonding curve.
Fees.Graduated Pool Trading Fees: Fees charged by the Sprout hook on swaps in graduated Choice v2 pools (FeeTaken events).

Revenue.Trading Fees To Platform: Bonding curve trading fees minus creator and referral fees.
Revenue.Graduated Pool Fees To Platform: Graduated pool fees minus the creator share (fee * (10000 - creatorBps) / 10000).

SupplySideRevenue.Trading Fees To Creators: Bonding curve fees credited to launch creators (CreatorFeeAccrued).
SupplySideRevenue.Trading Fees To Referrers: Bonding curve fees credited to referrers (ReferralFeeAccrued).
SupplySideRevenue.Graduated Pool Fees To Creators: Graduated pool fees credited to launch creators (fee * creatorBps / 10000).

ProtocolRevenue.Trading Fees To Protocol: Platform share not used for SPROUT buyback and burn.

HoldersRevenue.Trading Fees To SPROUT Buyback And Burn: 80% of the platform share (curve and graduated pools) used to buy back and burn SPROUT.

methodology.Fees: 1% swap fees on Pumper-launched tokens' Uniswap V3 pools and on the PUMPER pools, plus creator-set buy/sell taxes and the V4 hook / Lock-curve fees (1% base fee + tax) on Pumper-launched tokens. Launched tokens are taken from PumperProtocolRegistry.
methodology.Revenue: 15% of every launched token's fees and taxes: 10% to adminVault and 5% to the PUMPER buy-and-burn vault. PUMPER's own pool fees carry no protocol cut.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: The 10% of launched token fees and taxes paid to adminVault, the protocol treasury.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: The 5% of launched token fees and taxes sent to the PUMPER buy-and-burn vault, which buys and burns PUMPER.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: 5% of launched token fees and taxes sent to the FEFER buy-and-burn vault (FEFER is a separate token), and 80% split between each token's creator, stakers, buyback-and-burn and liquidity in a ratio the creator fixes at launch; plus 100% of PUMPER pool fees, paid to its LPs.

Fees.Launched Token Swap Fees: 1% swap fees on Uniswap V3 pools of tokens launched through Pumper, taken on the input token; fees paid in the launched token are valued at the pool price after the swap.
Fees.Launched Token Trade Tax: Creator-set buy/sell taxes on tokens from Pumper's V3 launchpads, taken on trades through the launchpad.
Fees.V4 And Lock Hook Base Fee Plus Trade Tax: Fees taken by the V4 / Lock launchpad hooks on every swap and by the Lock launchpad on curve trades: a 1% base fee plus the creator-set tax, reported together as one TaxNotified amount per collection.
Fees.PUMPER Swap Fees: 1% swap fees on the PUMPER/USDT0 and PUMPER/WgUSDT pools, taken on the input token; fees paid in PUMPER are valued at the pool price after the swap.

Revenue.Fees To Admin Vault: 10% of launched token fees and taxes, sent to adminVault.
Revenue.Fees To PUMPER Buy And Burn Vault: 5% of launched token fees and taxes, sent to the PUMPER buy-and-burn vault.

ProtocolRevenue.Fees To Admin Vault: 10% of launched token fees and taxes, sent to adminVault, the protocol treasury.

HoldersRevenue.Fees To PUMPER Buy And Burn Vault: 5% of launched token fees and taxes, used to buy and burn PUMPER.

SupplySideRevenue.Fees To FEFER Buy And Burn Vault: 5% of launched token fees and taxes, used to buy and burn FEFER, a separate token.
SupplySideRevenue.Fees To Creators And Token Stakers: 80% of launched token fees and taxes, split between creator, stakers, buyback-and-burn and liquidity per the creator's fixed split.
SupplySideRevenue.PUMPER Swap Fees To LPs: 100% of PUMPER pool fees, paid to its liquidity providers.

methodology.UserFees: Every fee traders pay on Bordrless DEX trades: the protocol fee, LP fee, coin creator fee and holder reward fee.
methodology.Fees: Every fee traders pay on trades on the Bordrless DEX, including launched coins after they graduate: the protocol fee, LP fee, coin creator fee and holder reward fee.
methodology.Revenue: The protocol fee, paid to the Bordrless treasury: half is kept, half buys back $BORDR.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Half of the protocol fee, kept by the treasury.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Half of the protocol fee, spent buying back $BORDR.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Fees paid to liquidity providers, coin creators and coin holders.
methodology.Volume: Sum of trades on the Bordrless DEX, including launched coins after they graduate.

Fees.Trading Fees: Every fee traders pay on a trade: the Bordrless protocol fee, the LP fee kept by the pool, the fee the coin's creator set and the fee the coin sets aside for its holders.

Revenue.Trading Fees To Protocol: The protocol fee, paid to the Bordrless treasury: half is kept, half buys back $BORDR.

ProtocolRevenue.Trading Fees To Treasury: Half of the protocol fee, kept by the treasury.

HoldersRevenue.BORDR Buy Back: Half of the protocol fee, spent buying back $BORDR.

SupplySideRevenue.LP Fees To Liquidity Providers: The LP fee, kept by the pool.
SupplySideRevenue.Creator Fees To Coin Creators: The creator fee, paid to the coin's creator.
SupplySideRevenue.Holder Reward Fees To Coin Holders: The holder reward fee, paid to the coin's holders.

methodology.Volume: Sum of trades on the Bordrless launchpad bonding curve, before a coin graduates.
methodology.Fees: Every fee traders pay on trades on the Bordrless launchpad bonding curve, before a coin graduates: the protocol fee, LP fee, coin creator fee and holder reward fee.
methodology.UserFees: Every fee traders pay on Bordrless launchpad bonding curve trades: the protocol fee, LP fee, coin creator fee and holder reward fee.
methodology.Revenue: The protocol fee, paid to the Bordrless treasury: half is kept, half buys back $BORDR.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Half of the protocol fee, kept by the treasury.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Half of the protocol fee, spent buying back $BORDR.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Fees paid to liquidity providers, coin creators and coin holders.

Fees.Trading Fees: Every fee traders pay on a trade: the Bordrless protocol fee, the LP fee kept by the pool, the fee the coin's creator set and the fee the coin sets aside for its holders.

Revenue.Trading Fees To Protocol: The protocol fee, paid to the Bordrless treasury: half is kept, half buys back $BORDR.

ProtocolRevenue.Trading Fees To Treasury: Half of the protocol fee, kept by the treasury.

HoldersRevenue.BORDR Buy Back: Half of the protocol fee, spent buying back $BORDR.

SupplySideRevenue.LP Fees To Liquidity Providers: The LP fee, kept by the pool.
SupplySideRevenue.Creator Fees To Coin Creators: The creator fee, paid to the coin's creator.
SupplySideRevenue.Holder Reward Fees To Coin Holders: The holder reward fee, paid to the coin's holders.

methodology.Fees: Creator trading fees that Pons pays to Credence vaults for the tokens Credence deployed, creator fees paid into creator vaults for X accounts, and the Credence fee charged on every launch.
methodology.UserFees: Creator trading fees paid by traders of Credence tokens on Pons, and the Credence fee paid by token creators at launch.
methodology.Revenue: What Credence keeps: 20% of each token vault's creator fees, which buys back and burns $PFWA, the protocol's cut of creator vault fees, and launch fees.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Revenue sent to the Credence Safe: the protocol's cut of creator vault fees and the launch fees.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: The 20% of each token vault's creator fees that is spent buying $PFWA sent to the dead address, counted when the fees are collected.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: 80% of each token vault's creator fees, bridged to Polygon to fund the token's Polymarket bet (whose winnings buy back and burn the token), and the creator vault fees held for the X account they belong to.

Fees.Creator Trading Fees: Pons creator trading fees collected by a Credence token's vault (v2 vaults when collected, v1 vaults when harvested), in WETH.
Fees.Creator Vault Fees: Pons creator trading fees paid into a CreatorFeeVault for the X account a token was launched for, in the token's pair asset.
Fees.Launch Fees: The Credence fee each launch pays on top of Pons' own launch fee.

UserFees.Creator Trading Fees: Creator trading fees paid by traders of Credence tokens on Pons.
UserFees.Creator Vault Fees: Creator trading fees paid by traders of creator-vault tokens on Pons.
UserFees.Launch Fees: The Credence fee paid by the token's creator at launch.

Revenue.Creator Trading Fees To PFWA Buyback: 20% of a token vault's creator fees, which the harvest spends buying back and burning $PFWA.
Revenue.Creator Vault Fees To Protocol: The protocol's cut of each creator vault fee arrival (protocolBps, 10%), sent to the Credence Safe in the same transaction.
Revenue.Launch Fees To Protocol: Launch fees, withdrawn from the launchers by the Credence Safe.

ProtocolRevenue.Creator Vault Fees To Protocol: The protocol's cut of each creator vault fee arrival (protocolBps, 10%).
ProtocolRevenue.Launch Fees To Protocol: Launch fees, withdrawn from the launchers by the Credence Safe.

HoldersRevenue.PFWA Buyback And Burn: 20% of a token vault's creator fees, which the next harvest swaps for $PFWA on the 1% WETH/PFWA Uniswap v3 pool and sends to the dead address.

SupplySideRevenue.Creator Trading Fees To Prediction Bets: 80% of a token vault's creator fees, bridged to the token's PolyVault on Polygon to buy its Polymarket outcome; winnings buy back and burn the token.
SupplySideRevenue.Creator Vault Fees To Creators: Creator vault fees after the protocol's cut, held for the X account until it claims them.

methodology.Fees: Everything traders and market creators pay on PFWA Markets: the trading fee on buys and on sells after a market's deadline, the early-sell penalty on sells before the deadline, and the fee to create a market. Activity of PFWA's own wallets (team, market seeder, market-making agent) is excluded.
methodology.UserFees: Everything traders and market creators pay on PFWA Markets: trading fees, early-sell penalties and market creation fees.
methodology.Revenue: The protocol's share of all fees: the protocol's leg of every trading fee (both legs on markets the protocol created), half of every early-sell penalty, and the market creation fee, including the part spent buying back and burning $PFWA.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: The fees sent to the PFWA treasury: the protocol's leg of every trading fee (both legs on markets the protocol created), half of every early-sell penalty, and the part of each market creation fee not used for the $PFWA buyback.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: ETH spent buying $PFWA that is burned: half of each v2 market creation fee is swapped for $PFWA in the same transaction and sent to the dead address.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The market creator's leg of the trading fee on markets created by users, and the half of each early-sell penalty paid into the market's bonus pot for the winning side.

Fees.Trading Fees: The fee on buys and on sells after a market's deadline: feePercentage per mille of the trade, charged once for the market creator and once for the protocol (1% + 1% on current markets, 1.5% + 1.5% on older ones).
Fees.Early Sell Penalties: The penalty on sells before a market's deadline: sellFeePercentage per mille of the proceeds (10% on current markets).
Fees.Market Creation Fees: The flat fee paid to create a market (0.001 ETH on the v2 factory, 0.0005 ETH on v1). Markets the protocol's relayer creates pay none.

UserFees.Trading Fees: The fee on buys and on sells after a market's deadline, paid by the trader.
UserFees.Early Sell Penalties: The penalty on sells before a market's deadline, paid by the seller.
UserFees.Market Creation Fees: The flat fee paid by the market's creator.

Revenue.Trading Fees To Protocol: The protocol's leg of the trading fee, plus the creator's leg on markets whose creator is the PFWA treasury.
Revenue.Early Sell Penalties To Protocol: Half of each early-sell penalty, sent to the PFWA treasury.
Revenue.Market Creation Fees To Protocol: The part of the market creation fee sent to the PFWA treasury (all of it on v1, half on v2).
Revenue.Market Creation Fees To PFWA Buyback: The part of each v2 market creation fee spent buying back and burning $PFWA (half, buybackBurnPercentage 5000 bps).

ProtocolRevenue.Trading Fees To Protocol: The protocol's leg of the trading fee, plus the creator's leg on markets whose creator is the PFWA treasury.
ProtocolRevenue.Early Sell Penalties To Protocol: Half of each early-sell penalty, sent to the PFWA treasury.
ProtocolRevenue.Market Creation Fees To Protocol: The part of the market creation fee sent to the PFWA treasury.

HoldersRevenue.PFWA Buyback And Burn: WETH the v2 factory spends on $PFWA (1% WETH/PFWA Uniswap v3 pool) that it then transfers to the dead address, inside each paid market creation.

SupplySideRevenue.Trading Fees To Market Creators: The market creator's leg of the trading fee, on markets created by users.
SupplySideRevenue.Early Sell Penalties To Winners: Half of each early-sell penalty, added to the market's bonus pot and paid to the winning side when the market resolves.

methodology.Fees: The 5% of the ETH side of every swap in a Sherwood game pool that is paid into the round's prize pot. Direct deposits into the pots are not fees and are excluded.
methodology.UserFees: The 5% of the ETH side of every swap in a Sherwood game pool, paid by the swapper into the round's prize pot.
methodology.Revenue: The share of the pot fees that buys back and burns $PFWA: 10% in Season 1 (ETH/$PFWA pool) and 7% in Season 2 (ETH/$IMD pool) of what is left after the Dice randomness fees.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Zero: the protocol keeps none of the pot fees.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: The share of the pot fees spent buying back and burning $PFWA (10% in Season 1, 7% in Season 2, after Dice randomness fees), counted when the swap pays the fee. Burns funded by direct pot deposits are excluded.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The Dice Protocol fees paid from the pot for Flip moves, then the share of the remaining pot fees paid to players: the round's prizes (80% in Season 1, 78% in Season 2), the share rolled into the next round's pot (10% and 5%), and in Season 2 the 10% that buys back and burns $IMD, the game pool's token.

Fees.Pot Fees: 5% of the ETH side of every swap in a Sherwood game pool, paid into the round's prize pot.

UserFees.Pot Fees: 5% of the ETH side of every swap in a Sherwood game pool, paid by the swapper.

Revenue.Pot Fees To PFWA Buyback And Burn: The pot share that buys back and burns $PFWA: 10% in Season 1, 7% in Season 2, of the pot fees left after Dice fees.

HoldersRevenue.PFWA Buyback And Burn: The pot share that buys back and burns $PFWA: 10% in Season 1, 7% in Season 2, of the pot fees left after Dice fees, counted when the swap pays the fee.

SupplySideRevenue.Pot Fees To Dice Randomness: The Dice Protocol randomness fee each Flip move pays out of the pot (Dice's getFeeV2, read at the end of the period).
SupplySideRevenue.Pot Fees To Winners: The round's prizes: 50/20/10% to the top three in Season 1; 40/20/10% to the top three and 8% to the King of the Hill in Season 2. Referral cuts, forfeited and unclaimed prizes stay within the players' pots.
SupplySideRevenue.Pot Fees Rolled Into Next Round: The share that rolls into the next round's pot (10% in Season 1, 5% in Season 2).
SupplySideRevenue.Pot Fees To IMD Buyback And Burn: Season 2 only: the 10% that buys back and burns $IMD, the game pool's token (not PFWA's).

methodology.Fees: Fees paid by traders on MoveFast launchpad pools: the platform trading fee, any pool fee, and the token tax each launch's creator sets. The part of the tax that burns the launched token is not included.
methodology.Revenue: The platform trading fee on every MoveFast trade (1.5% of the trade), sent to the MoveFast treasury.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: The platform trading fee on every MoveFast trade (1.5% of the trade), sent to the MoveFast treasury.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The token tax paid out to holders and creators of the launched tokens, plus any pool fee kept in the pool's reserves.

Fees.Trading Fees: MoveFast's platform fee, charged on every buy and sell (treasury_fee_bps, 150 bps on the current deployment, 50 bps on the earlier one).
Fees.LP Fees: Pool fee charged on each trade and kept in the pool's reserves (pool_fee_bps, 0 on the current deployment, 100 bps on the earlier one).
Fees.Token Tax: Creator-set tax on each trade, capped at 5%, split on chain between the token's holders, its creator and a burn. Only the holder and creator shares are counted; the burned share is paid in the launched token and is excluded.

Revenue.Trading Fees To Treasury: The platform fee, deposited to the MoveFast treasury on every trade.

ProtocolRevenue.Trading Fees To Treasury: The platform fee, deposited to the MoveFast treasury on every trade.

SupplySideRevenue.Pool Fees To Pool Reserves: The pool fee, kept in the pool's reserves.
SupplySideRevenue.Token Tax To Token Holders: The holder share of the token tax, escrowed in the token's rewards vault and paid in the quote asset to that token's holders through Merkle-snapshot epochs. These are holders of the launched token, not of a MoveFast token, so this is a supply-side cost rather than holders revenue.
SupplySideRevenue.Token Tax To Creators: The creator share of the token tax, claimable by the token's creator.

methodology.Fees: Swap fees paid by traders on Choice v1 pools, which is 0.3% of the swap output.
methodology.Revenue: One sixth of each swap fee, kept by the protocol in the Choice treasury multisig.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: One sixth of each swap fee, sent to the Choice treasury multisig.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Money going to governance token holders
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Five sixths of each swap fee: two thirds stays in the pool for liquidity providers and one sixth goes to the Injective burn auction, which burns INJ.
methodology.Volume: Value traded on Choice v1 liquidity pools on Injective, counted on the input side of each swap; Choice v2 pools are a separate listing.

Fees.Swap Fees: Swap fees paid by traders on Choice v1 pools.

Revenue.Swap Fees To Treasury: One sixth of each swap fee, sent to the Choice treasury multisig.

ProtocolRevenue.Swap Fees To Treasury: One sixth of each swap fee, sent to the Choice treasury multisig.

SupplySideRevenue.Swap Fees To LPs: Two thirds of each swap fee, left in the pool for liquidity providers.
SupplySideRevenue.Swap Fees To Burn Auction: One sixth of each swap fee, sent to the Injective burn auction, which burns INJ.

methodology.Fees: The 1% fee the Feast hook takes on every buy and sell of a Feast coin, paid in the coin's quote asset (a Binance tokenized stock or BNB). Excludes the PancakeSwap Infinity LP fee and the one-off 1% fee on the FEAST token sale.
methodology.UserFees: The 1% fee traders pay on every buy and sell of a Feast coin.
methodology.Revenue: The 20% platform share of every fee, plus the self-burn and creator shares of fees in the FEAST/BNB pool, all of which are used to buy and burn the FEAST platform token.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: No part of the fee goes to a team treasury: the platform share is used only to buy and burn FEAST.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: The 20% platform share of every fee, sold by the platform sink for FEAST which is burned, plus the self-burn and creator shares of fees in the FEAST/BNB pool, which buy and burn FEAST.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The rest of each fee, split as the coin's creator fixed it at launch: the creator's share, the referrer's share on referred trades, and the share used to buy back and burn the launched coin itself.

Fees.Token Swap Fees: 1% of every buy and sell in a Feast pool, taken by the Feast hook on the quote leg (FeeAccrued).

UserFees.Token Swap Fees: 1% of every buy and sell in a Feast pool, paid by the trader.

Revenue.Swap Fees To Platform: 20% of every fee, sent to the platform sink, which sells it for FEAST and burns the FEAST.
Revenue.FEAST Pool Swap Fees To Burn: In the FEAST/BNB pool, whose creator is the burn address, the self-burn and creator shares, which buy and burn FEAST.

HoldersRevenue.Token Buy Back: Fees used to buy and burn FEAST: the 20% platform share of every fee, and the self-burn and creator shares of the FEAST/BNB pool.

SupplySideRevenue.Swap Fees To Creators: The creator's share of each fee: 80% less the coin's self-burn share and, on referred trades, the referrer's share (60%, or 50% on referred trades, at the default shares).
SupplySideRevenue.Swap Fees To Referrers: The referrer's share (10% by default, at most 30%) of fees on trades that name a referrer, claimable by the referrer.
SupplySideRevenue.Swap Fees To Coin Buy Back And Burn: The self-burn share (20% by default, at most 50%) of each fee, used to buy back and burn the launched coin in its own pool; for coins launched with the burn address as creator, the creator share too.

methodology.Fees: Fees charged when positions settle: a 0.5 basis point close charge on the order value plus the market fee (currently 2%) on the gain of winning trades and on the loss of losing and liquidated trades. Opening a position is free and there are no funding payments.
methodology.Revenue: All settlement fees, split between the protocol and CARDBOARD stakers.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Half of settlement fees, allocated to the protocol fee recipient.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Half of settlement fees, distributed in USDC to CARDBOARD stakers. Referral bonuses are paid from the same budget and are not separated.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: LPs revenue

Fees.Close Fees: Fees on positions closed without being liquidated, whether the close is sent by the owner or by the exchange's relayer: the 0.5 basis point close charge on the order value plus the market fee on the gain of a winning trade or on the house's gain from a losing one.
Fees.Liquidation Fees: Market fee on the margin forfeited by liquidated positions, including closes that executed past the bust price.

Revenue.Trading Fees To CARDBOARD Stakers: Half of settlement fees, put into the USDC rewards budget for CARDBOARD stakers.
Revenue.Trading Fees To Protocol: Half of settlement fees, allocated to the protocol fee recipient.

ProtocolRevenue.Trading Fees To Protocol: Half of settlement fees, allocated to the protocol fee recipient.

HoldersRevenue.Trading Fees To CARDBOARD Stakers: Half of settlement fees, put into the USDC rewards budget for CARDBOARD stakers.

methodology.Fees: 2% fee on the profit of every winning trade, taken from the payout. Opening, losing trades and liquidations are free. The house bankroll's trading profit is not counted.
methodology.Revenue: All profit fees, kept by Jupiter. There are no liquidity providers.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: All of profit fees, kept by Jupiter. Not used for JUP buybacks.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Fees going to governance token holders
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: LPs revenue

Fees.Profit Fees: 2% of the profit on each winning trade, deducted from the payout.

Revenue.Profit Fees To Jupiter: All profit fees, kept by Jupiter.

ProtocolRevenue.Profit Fees To Jupiter: All of profit fees, kept by Jupiter.

methodology.UserFees: Swap fees paid by traders, at the dynamic fee the Nami plugin sets for each swap.
methodology.Fees: Swap fees paid by traders, at the dynamic fee the Nami plugin sets for each swap.
methodology.Revenue: Swap fees of gauged pools, paid to Nami token holders: 90% to veNAMI voters and 10% to ogNAMI stakers.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Swap fees paid to Nami fee receivers other than Algebra, veNAMI voters and ogNAMI stakers.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Swap fees of gauged pools paid to veNAMI voters (90%) and ogNAMI stakers (10%).
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Swap fees of permissionless pools: 99% to liquidity providers and 1% to Algebra as the DEX licence fee.
methodology.Volume: Swap volume across all Nami V4 concentrated liquidity pools.

Fees.Token Swap Fees: Swap fees paid by traders, at the per-swap fee emitted in the pool's SwapFee event.

UserFees.Token Swap Fees: Swap fees paid by traders, at the per-swap fee emitted in the pool's SwapFee event.

Revenue.Swap Fees To veNAMI Voters: 90% of gauged pools' swap fees, paid through the gauge to veNAMI voters.
Revenue.Swap Fees To ogNAMI Stakers: 10% of gauged pools' swap fees, converted and deposited into the ogNAMI staking contract.
Revenue.Swap Fees To Other Fee Receivers: Swap fees paid by a pool's fee vault to a receiver not identified as Algebra or ogNAMI stakers.

ProtocolRevenue.Swap Fees To Other Fee Receivers: Swap fees paid by a pool's fee vault to a receiver not identified as Algebra or ogNAMI stakers.

HoldersRevenue.Swap Fees To veNAMI Voters: 90% of gauged pools' swap fees, paid through the gauge to veNAMI voters.
HoldersRevenue.Swap Fees To ogNAMI Stakers: 10% of gauged pools' swap fees, converted and deposited into the ogNAMI staking contract.

SupplySideRevenue.Swap Fees To LPs: Swap fees of permissionless pools kept by liquidity providers (99%).
SupplySideRevenue.Swap Fees To Algebra: Algebra's licence fee, 1% of permissionless pools' swap fees.

methodology.Fees: Management and performance fees paid by vault investors (the manager's and FBYT's parts), plus the SOL trading fee paid on every vault swap and the SOL fee paid to create a vault.
methodology.UserFees: All fees: investors pay the management and performance fees, managers (or their trading delegates) pay the trading and vault creation fees.
methodology.Revenue: FBYT's share of the management and performance fees, plus all trading and vault creation fees.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: FBYT's share of the management and performance fees, plus all trading and vault creation fees.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The money managers' share of the management and performance fees.

Fees.Management Fees: Yearly management fee on the vault's assets, set per vault by its manager, paid in the vault's tokens when it is paid out to the manager.
Fees.Performance Fees: Fee on the investor's profit above their high-water mark, set per vault by its manager, charged when the investor withdraws.
Fees.Trading Fees: SOL fee paid by the trade's signer on every vault swap: 0.001 SOL per swap until 2026-10-01, then a tiered % of the trade's USD value.
Fees.Vault Creation Fees: SOL fee paid by the money manager to create a vault (0.002 SOL).

UserFees.Trading Fees: Paid by the money manager or their trading delegate.

Revenue.Management Fees To FBYT: FBYT's protocol share of the management fee (20%).
Revenue.Performance Fees To FBYT: FBYT's protocol share of the performance fee (20%).

ProtocolRevenue.Management Fees To FBYT: FBYT's protocol share of the management fee, sent to the FBYT admin wallet.
ProtocolRevenue.Performance Fees To FBYT: FBYT's protocol share of the performance fee, sent to the FBYT admin wallet.
ProtocolRevenue.Trading Fees To FBYT: All trading fees, sent to the FBYT admin wallet.
ProtocolRevenue.Vault Creation Fees To FBYT: All vault creation fees, sent to the FBYT admin wallet.

SupplySideRevenue.Management Fees To Managers: The money manager's share of the management fee (80%).
SupplySideRevenue.Performance Fees To Managers: The money manager's share of the performance fee (80%).

methodology.Volume: Completed swaps routed by WormSwap, counted once using the received input before its router fee; the received output is used when only that leg is a core asset, and BNB/WBNB wrapping is excluded.
methodology.Fees: User-paid swap and BNB/WBNB wrapping fees actually credited to WormSwap's fee distributor before protocol allocations, excluding external token transfer taxes, underlying DEX fees, Arena payments and donations.
methodology.Revenue: Net swap and wrapping fee receipts retained by WormSwap and allocated entirely to TANUKI buybacks and burns, with no supplier or referral share.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Net swap and wrapping fee receipts earmarked for TANUKI buybacks and burns, recognized when received rather than again when the burn batch executes.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: WormSwap allocates none of its net router fee receipts to a discretionary treasury; all are reserved for TANUKI buybacks and burns.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: WormSwap pays no supplier or referral share from its router fee; underlying PancakeSwap liquidity-provider fees belong to PancakeSwap.

Fees.Swap and BNB Wrapping Fees: Actual native/ERC20 credits from the WormSwap router to its fee distributor, matched to successful SwapExecuted transactions, including the fee on BNB/WBNB wrapping.

Revenue.Fees Allocated to TANUKI Buybacks and Bu: All net router fee receipts are committed to TANUKI buybacks and burns by the fee distributor's fixed 100% burn allocation.

HoldersRevenue.Fees Allocated to TANUKI Buybacks and Bu: The fee-funded TANUKI buyback/burn allocation measured at fee collection; later keeper conversions and burns are not counted a second time.

methodology.Fees: The 10% tax traders pay on PSTR buys and sells, plus the USDC yield earned by the PAPER the treasury has staked on Papertrade, valued at the HYPE it is swapped to and counted when the buyback contract spends it. Tax paid by the buyback contract's own purchases is excluded, since it is paid out of that yield.
methodology.UserFees: The 10% tax traders pay on PSTR buys and sells.
methodology.Revenue: All fees: the trade tax goes to the team and the treasury and the yield goes to the team and the buyback.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: The trade tax (one tenth to the team, nine tenths to the treasury that acquires and stakes PAPER), the team's 10% share of the staking yield, and the tax the buyback contract pays on its own PSTR purchases.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: The staking yield the buyback contract spends buying PSTR and burning it, net of the 10% tax it pays on those purchases.

Fees.PSTR Trade Tax: 10% tax on PSTR buys and sells paid by traders, valued at the HYPE the contract sells tax PSTR for, or at the PSTR market price when none is sold in the period.
Fees.Staked PAPER Yield: USDC staking yield earned by the treasury's PAPER on Papertrade, swapped to WHYPE and sent to the buyback contract.

UserFees.PSTR Trade Tax: 10% tax on PSTR buys and sells paid by traders, valued at the HYPE the contract sells tax PSTR for, or at the PSTR market price when none is sold in the period.

Revenue.PSTR Trade Tax: 10% tax on PSTR buys and sells paid by traders, valued at the HYPE the contract sells tax PSTR for, or at the PSTR market price when none is sold in the period.
Revenue.Staked PAPER Yield: USDC staking yield earned by the treasury's PAPER on Papertrade, swapped to WHYPE and sent to the buyback contract.

ProtocolRevenue.PSTR Trade Tax: Trade tax split one tenth to the team and nine tenths to the treasury.
ProtocolRevenue.Staked PAPER Yield To Team: The team's 10% share of the staking yield, paid by the buyback contract.
ProtocolRevenue.Staked PAPER Yield Via Buyback Tax: The 10% tax the buyback contract pays on its own PSTR purchases, which goes to the team and the treasury like any other trade tax.

HoldersRevenue.PSTR Buyback And Burn: WHYPE the buyback contract spends buying PSTR that it burns, net of the tax on those purchases.

methodology.Fees: The 2% fee on every buy and sell of a coin launched on Sapling, the flat fee paid to plant a coin, and Sapling's fee on buys, plantings and sales made from a Zcash account. On Robinhood Chain: the 2% creator tax plus the creator's 70% of Pons's 1% fee on every buy and sell of a coin planted through Sapling, both paid to Sapling's splitter, plus the planting fee and the Zcash account fee, paid in USDG to the treasury. On Raydium LaunchLab (from 2026-10-28): any platform fee claimed from the curve and Sapling's fees from the coin's graduated pool; excludes the coin's transfer tax (Sapling's 2.00% plus the deployer's tax of none to 3%), which is taken on every transfer of the coin, wallet to wallet included.
methodology.Revenue: The part of the 2% coin trading fee Sapling keeps (10% treasury, 25% $SAPLING buyback and burn, 25% $SAPLING/ZEC liquidity), plus the planting fee and the Zcash account fee. For LaunchLab coins, all of the curve platform fee and the graduated pool's fees (a quarter each to the treasury, the flywheel, $SAPLING buyback and burn, and the protocol-owned $SAPLING/ZEC pool). On Robinhood Chain the shares apply to what reaches Sapling's splitter: the 2% creator tax plus the creator's 70% of Pons's 1% fee.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: The treasury's share: 10% of the 2% coin trading fee, plus the planting fee and the Zcash account fee. For LaunchLab coins, the treasury's and the flywheel's quarters of the curve platform fee and the graduated pool's fees. On Robinhood Chain the shares apply to what reaches Sapling's splitter: the 2% creator tax plus the creator's 70% of Pons's 1% fee.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: 50% of the 2% coin trading fee: 25% buys and burns $SAPLING, and 25% goes to the $SAPLING/ZEC pool on PumpSwap, where about half of it buys $SAPLING, both sides are deposited and the LP tokens are burned, so no one, Sapling included, can withdraw it. On Robinhood Chain the shares apply to what reaches Sapling's splitter: the 2% creator tax plus the creator's 70% of Pons's 1% fee. For LaunchLab coins, half of the curve platform fee and the graduated pool's fees: $SAPLING buyback and burn, and the protocol-owned $SAPLING/ZEC pool, whose position is locked for good.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: 40% of the 2% coin trading fee, paid to each coin's deployer, a wallet they choose, or the holders of that coin as holder rewards (on Robinhood Chain, 40% of what reaches Sapling's splitter). LaunchLab coins pay their deployers from the coin's transfer tax, which is not counted.

Fees.Coin Trading Fees: The 2% fee on every buy and sell of a coin launched on Sapling, collected and split on chain by the Sapling vault program. On Robinhood Chain: the 2% creator tax plus the creator's 70% of Pons's 1% fee, paid to Sapling's splitter and split there. For LaunchLab coins: any platform fee claimed from the curve and Sapling's fees from the graduated pool, both in ZEC (the coin's transfer tax is not counted).
Fees.Zcash Account Fees: Sapling's fee on a buy, planting or sale made from a Zcash account.
Fees.Coin Planting Fees: The flat fee paid to the Sapling treasury when a coin is planted, in the same transaction that creates the coin.

Revenue.Coin Trading Fees To Treasury: 10% of the 2% coin trading fee, sent to the Sapling treasury. On Robinhood Chain the share is of what reaches Sapling's splitter. For LaunchLab coins, a quarter of the curve platform fee and the graduated pool's fees.
Revenue.Coin Planting Fees To Treasury: The flat planting fee, sent to the Sapling treasury.
Revenue.Zcash Account Fees To Treasury: The Zcash account fee, sent to the Sapling treasury.
Revenue.Sapling Coins Buyback And Burn: A quarter of the curve platform fee and the graduated pool's fees of LaunchLab coins, spent buying back and burning the top Sapling coins.
Revenue.Token Buy Back: 25% of the 2% coin trading fee, used to buy $SAPLING and burn it (burned directly for coins paired with $SAPLING). On Robinhood Chain the share is of what reaches Sapling's splitter. For LaunchLab coins, a quarter of the curve platform fee and the graduated pool's fees.
Revenue.$SAPLING/ZEC Liquidity: 25% of the 2% coin trading fee, added to the $SAPLING/ZEC pool on PumpSwap: about half of it buys $SAPLING, both sides are deposited and the LP tokens are burned, so no one, Sapling included, can withdraw it (held in a vault per coin before 2026-10-02, then moved into the same liquidity). On Robinhood Chain the share is of what reaches Sapling's splitter. For LaunchLab coins, a quarter of the curve platform fee and the graduated pool's fees, added to a protocol-owned $SAPLING/ZEC pool whose position is locked for good.

ProtocolRevenue.Coin Trading Fees To Treasury: 10% of the 2% coin trading fee, sent to the Sapling treasury. On Robinhood Chain the share is of what reaches Sapling's splitter. For LaunchLab coins, a quarter of the curve platform fee and the graduated pool's fees.
ProtocolRevenue.Coin Planting Fees To Treasury: The flat planting fee, sent to the Sapling treasury.
ProtocolRevenue.Zcash Account Fees To Treasury: The Zcash account fee, sent to the Sapling treasury.
ProtocolRevenue.Sapling Coins Buyback And Burn: A quarter of the curve platform fee and the graduated pool's fees of LaunchLab coins, spent buying back and burning the top Sapling coins.

HoldersRevenue.Token Buy Back: 25% of the 2% coin trading fee, used to buy $SAPLING and burn it (burned directly for coins paired with $SAPLING). On Robinhood Chain the share is of what reaches Sapling's splitter. For LaunchLab coins, a quarter of the curve platform fee and the graduated pool's fees.
HoldersRevenue.$SAPLING/ZEC Liquidity: 25% of the 2% coin trading fee, added to the $SAPLING/ZEC pool on PumpSwap: about half of it buys $SAPLING, both sides are deposited and the LP tokens are burned, so no one, Sapling included, can withdraw it (held in a vault per coin before 2026-10-02, then moved into the same liquidity). On Robinhood Chain the share is of what reaches Sapling's splitter. For LaunchLab coins, a quarter of the curve platform fee and the graduated pool's fees, added to a protocol-owned $SAPLING/ZEC pool whose position is locked for good.

SupplySideRevenue.Coin Trading Fees To Deployers: 40% of the 2% coin trading fee, paid to the coin's deployer or a wallet they choose. On Robinhood Chain the share is of what reaches Sapling's splitter.
SupplySideRevenue.Coin Trading Fees To Coin Holders: 40% of the 2% coin trading fee of coins whose deployer chose holder rewards, paid in ZEC to the holders of that coin. On Robinhood Chain the share is of what reaches Sapling's splitter.
SupplySideRevenue.Coin Trading Fees To Deployers Or Coin H: On Robinhood Chain, the 40% share of fees Pons's escrow held before a sweep tied them to a coin, paid later to that coin's deployer or holders.

methodology.Fees: Swap fees paid by traders, plus bribes paid to the protocol to attract AERO Rewards to pools.
methodology.Revenue: Swap fees earned by AERO-earning liquidity and bribes, all distributed to sAERO holders.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Percentage of swap fees going to treasury
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Swap fees earned by AERO-earning liquidity and bribes, all distributed to sAERO holders.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Swap fees kept by fee-earning liquidity providers.
methodology.Volume: Swap volume on Aero volatile and stable pools.

Fees.Token Swap Fees: Swap fees paid by traders.
Fees.External Bribes Rewards: Bribes (Aero calls them Liquidity Payments) paid to the protocol for a pool, counted as the protocol streams them out.

Revenue.Swap Fees To sAERO Holders: Swap fees earned by AERO-earning liquidity, distributed to sAERO holders.
Revenue.External Bribes Revenue: Bribes paid to the protocol, distributed to sAERO holders allocating to the pool.

HoldersRevenue.Swap Fees To sAERO Holders: Swap fees earned by AERO-earning liquidity, distributed to sAERO holders.
HoldersRevenue.External Bribes Revenue: Bribes paid to the protocol, distributed to sAERO holders allocating to the pool.

SupplySideRevenue.LP Fees: Swap fees kept by fee-earning liquidity providers.

methodology.Fees: Fees users pay Veil to shield tokens into its private pool, withdraw them, swap privately or fill a private DCA order, plus Veil's share of the relayer fee; network fees, Jupiter's swap fees and tokens swept from closed DCA escrows are not included.
methodology.UserFees: Fees users pay Veil to shield tokens into its private pool, withdraw them, swap privately or fill a private DCA order, plus Veil's share of the relayer fee they pay.
methodology.Revenue: All fees users pay Veil for shielding, withdrawals, private swaps and private DCA fills, plus its share of the relayer fee, all kept by Veil as it has no liquidity providers or stakers to pay.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: All fees users pay Veil, collected into the Veil treasury, minus the $VEIL the treasury buys back and burns with 20% of revenue, so it is negative on days when more is burned than earned.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: $VEIL bought on the market with 20% of Veil's revenue and burned, counted from the buyback wallet's on-chain burns at the token's price.

Fees.Shield Fees: The fee charged when tokens are shielded into Veil's private pool (0.3% of the amount in October 2026).
Fees.Withdrawal Fees: The fee charged when tokens are withdrawn from Veil's private pool to a public address (0.3% of the amount in October 2026).
Fees.Private Swap Fees: The fee charged on a swap made from inside Veil's private pool (0.3% of the input in October 2026).
Fees.Relayer Fee Share: Veil's share of the fee paid to the relayer that submits private transactions for the user.
Fees.Flow DCA Fees: The fee charged on each fill of a private DCA (Flow) order.

UserFees.Shield Fees: Paid by the user shielding tokens into Veil's private pool.
UserFees.Withdrawal Fees: Paid by the user withdrawing tokens from Veil's private pool.
UserFees.Private Swap Fees: Paid by the user making a swap from inside Veil's private pool.
UserFees.Relayer Fee Share: Paid by the user as part of the relayer fee.
UserFees.Flow DCA Fees: Paid by the owner of the private DCA order on each fill.

Revenue.Shield Fees To Treasury: All shield fees, collected into the Veil treasury.
Revenue.Withdrawal Fees To Treasury: All withdrawal fees, collected into the Veil treasury.
Revenue.Private Swap Fees To Treasury: All private swap fees, collected into the Veil treasury.
Revenue.Relayer Fee Share To Treasury: Veil's share of relayer fees, collected into the Veil treasury.
Revenue.Flow DCA Fees To Treasury: All private DCA fees, collected into the Veil treasury.

ProtocolRevenue.Fees To Treasury: All fees collected into the Veil treasury, a Squads multisig, minus the $VEIL bought back and burned with 20% of revenue.

HoldersRevenue.Token Buy Back: $VEIL bought on the market with 20% of Veil's revenue and burned by the buyback wallet, valued at the token's price.

methodology.Fees: Arbitrage profit made through the vaults' pools, as each vault's profit splitter pays it out.
methodology.Revenue: 25% of the profit: half to the fee jar, which buys GOO and burns it, and half to the development fund.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: 12.5% of the profit, paid to the development fund.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: 75% of the profit, compounded into the vault for its depositors.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: 12.5% of the profit, sent to the fee jar, which auctions it for GOO and burns the GOO.

Fees.Arbitrage Profits: Arbitrage profit made through the vaults' pools, as each vault's profit splitter pays it out.

SupplySideRevenue.Arbitrage Profits To Depositors: 75% of the profit, compounded into the vault for its depositors.

Revenue.Arbitrage Profits To GOO Buyback And Bur: 12.5% of the profit, sent to the fee jar, which auctions it for GOO and burns the GOO.
Revenue.Arbitrage Profits To Development Fund: 12.5% of the profit, paid to the development fund.

HoldersRevenue.Arbitrage Profits To GOO Buyback And Bur: 12.5% of the profit, sent to the fee jar, which auctions it for GOO and burns the GOO.

ProtocolRevenue.Arbitrage Profits To Development Fund: 12.5% of the profit, paid to the development fund.

methodology.Fees: A 0.5% fee on every cash-out from the Gloam shielded pool. Deposits and private payments are free.
methodology.UserFees: Users pay the 0.5% cash-out fee, taken from the amount they cash out.
methodology.Revenue: All cash-out fees go to the Gloam fee recipient.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: All cash-out fees go to the Gloam fee recipient.

Fees.Deposit/Withdraw Fees: 0.5% of every cash-out (unshield) from the pool, read from WithdrawFee events.

UserFees.Deposit/Withdraw Fees: 0.5% of every cash-out, paid by the user cashing out.

Revenue.Deposit/Withdraw Fees: All cash-out fees are kept by the protocol.

ProtocolRevenue.Deposit/Withdraw Fees: All cash-out fees go to the Gloam treasury 0xB3900ac9350903218e4c7597bAb0f008F01B30B8.

methodology.Fees: The fee the Stockereum hook charges on every swap, in the quote currency, from the hook's Trade event: 1% on v2 launches, 1%, 2% or 3% (chosen by the creator) on v3 launches, plus the anti-snipe rate in the first moments after a launch.
methodology.UserFees: Traders pay the whole swap fee.
methodology.Revenue: The platform's share of the swap fee: half of the normal 1% on v2, 0.5% of the trade on 1% v3 launches and 1% of the trade on 2% and 3% v3 launches, plus any anti-snipe excess.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: The platform's share of the swap fee.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The rest of the swap fee, paid to the launch's creator or, on launches with holder rewards enabled, to the launched token's holders.

Fees.Token Swap Fees: The hook's fee on each swap in a launch pool, in the quote currency.

Revenue.Swap Fees To Platform: The platform's share of the swap fee, credited to the platform in the fee escrow.

ProtocolRevenue.Swap Fees To Platform: The platform's share of the swap fee, credited to the platform in the fee escrow.

SupplySideRevenue.Swap Fees To Creators: The creator's share of the swap fee, credited to the creator in the fee escrow.
SupplySideRevenue.Swap Fees To Launched Token Holders: The creator's share on launches with holder rewards enabled, paid to the launched token's holders through its reward distributor.

methodology.Fees: Estimated borrowing fees, including supplier flashloan earnings, plus liquidation bonuses and the separately recorded protocol share of flashloan premiums; unpriced collateral bonuses are excluded from USD totals.
methodology.Revenue: Estimated reserve-factor share of borrowing fees, plus the protocol shares of liquidation bonuses and flashloan premiums; unpriced collateral bonuses are excluded from USD totals.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Estimated reserve-factor share of borrowing fees and the protocol shares of liquidation bonuses and flashloan premiums; unpriced collateral bonuses are excluded from USD totals.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Liquidity-index earnings for suppliers, including their flashloan premiums, and liquidation bonuses retained by liquidators; unpriced collateral bonuses are excluded from USD totals.

Fees.Borrow Interest: Opening aToken supply multiplied by relative liquidity-index growth, grossed up by the opening reserve factor; includes supplier flashloan earnings.
Fees.Liquidation Fees: Liquidation bonuses, paid in the seized collateral. Reental property tokens have no market price, so bonuses paid in them are not valued.
Fees.Flashloan Fees: Protocol share of flashloan premiums. The suppliers' share accrues to the liquidity index and is already counted in borrow interest.

Revenue.Borrow Interest: Estimated interest less supplier index earnings, using the reserve factor at the start of the window.
Revenue.Liquidation Fees: Liquidation protocol fee share of liquidation bonuses.

SupplySideRevenue.Borrow Interest: Opening aToken supply multiplied by relative liquidity-index growth, including supplier flashloan earnings.
SupplySideRevenue.Liquidation Fees: Liquidation bonuses kept by liquidators.

ProtocolRevenue.Borrow Interest: Reserve factor share of borrow interest kept by the RNT Lend treasury.
ProtocolRevenue.Liquidation Fees: Liquidation protocol fee share kept by the RNT Lend treasury.
ProtocolRevenue.Flashloan Fees: Protocol share of flashloan premiums kept by the RNT Lend treasury.

methodology.Fees: Total interest paid by borrowers
methodology.Revenue: Protocol and holders share of interest
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Protocol's share of interest into treasury
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Interest paid to lenders in liquidity pools
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Share of interest into protocol governance token holders.

Fees.Borrow Interest: Total interest paid by borrowers

Revenue.Borrow Interest: Share of borrow interest to treasury

ProtocolRevenue.Borrow Interest: Share of borrow interest to protocol

methodology.Volume: Gross quote-asset value of every buy and sell on CURB bonding curves (CurveBuy quoteIn; CurveSell quoteOut + fee + tax). Trading in graduated Uniswap v4 pools is excluded: it is counted by the Uniswap v4 adapter.
methodology.Fees: The trading tax (1%-5%, set per launch) paid on every curve and graduated-pool trade, in the quote asset. The pools' 0.05% Uniswap v4 LP fee is not included: it is earned by the pool's liquidity and already counted by the Uniswap v4 adapter.
methodology.UserFees: Traders pay the whole trading tax. Launching costs gas only.
methodology.Revenue: The platform's share of the tax (0.50% of the trade at deployment, frozen into each launch), plus the creator share of launches whose creator wallet is the treasury ($CURB).
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: The platform's share of the tax on both venues, plus the creator share of treasury-created launches ($CURB), paid to the treasury Safe.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The rest of the tax: to the launch's creator, or to the launch's own token holders through its distributor once holder sharing is on.

Fees.Bonding Curve Trading Tax: Platform share (fee) plus creator share (tax) of every CurveBuy and CurveSell on the bonding curve of a launch created by a CURB factory.
Fees.Graduated Pool Trading Tax: Every leg of the tax the FeeHook takes from a graduated pool swap, paid out (FeePaidDirect) or recorded as owed (FeeAccrued).

UserFees.Bonding Curve Trading Tax: Trading tax paid by bonding-curve traders.
UserFees.Graduated Pool Trading Tax: Trading tax paid by graduated-pool traders.

Revenue.Trading Tax To Treasury: The platform's share of the tax on both venues, plus the creator share of treasury-created launches ($CURB), paid to the treasury Safe.

ProtocolRevenue.Trading Tax To Treasury: The platform's share of the tax on both venues, plus the creator share of treasury-created launches ($CURB), paid to the treasury Safe.

SupplySideRevenue.Creator Fees: Creator share of the tax, paid to the launch's creator wallet.
SupplySideRevenue.Trading Tax To Launch Holders: Creator share of the tax on launches with holder sharing on, paid to the launch's distributor and split among that launch's token holders.

methodology.Fees: Every swap in a Phlece coin's Uniswap v4 pool pays a 0.98% base fee plus the creator's 1-10% tax, in the coin's paired asset (QuoteFeeTaken events of each coin's hook). Swaps in a coin's first 3 seconds also pay an anti-snipe surcharge. The pool's own LP fee is 0.
methodology.Revenue: 20% of every trading fee (the portal's platformBps) plus the whole anti-snipe surcharge go to the Phlece team Safe.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: 20% of every trading fee plus the anti-snipe surcharge, paid to the Phlece team Safe.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The other 80% of each trading fee, split by percentages the coin's creator fixed at launch between the creator, the coin's holders (dividends), buyback-and-burn of the coin, and liquidity added to the coin's locked pool position.

Fees.Trading Fees: 0.98% base fee plus the creator's 1-10% tax on every swap, in the paired asset.
Fees.Anti-Snipe Surcharge: Extra charge on swaps in a coin's first 3 seconds (99%, then 6.18%, then 0.19%).

Revenue.Trading Fees To Protocol Treasury: 20% of each trading fee, to the team Safe.
Revenue.Anti-Snipe Surcharge To Protocol Treasur: The whole anti-snipe surcharge, to the team Safe.

ProtocolRevenue.Trading Fees To Protocol Treasury: 20% of each trading fee, to the team Safe.
ProtocolRevenue.Anti-Snipe Surcharge To Protocol Treasur: The whole anti-snipe surcharge, to the team Safe.

SupplySideRevenue.Creator Fees: The creator's share of the remaining 80%, claimable by the creator's payout wallet.
SupplySideRevenue.Trading Fees To Launched Token Holders: The dividend share, claimable by the coin's holders pro rata.
SupplySideRevenue.Trading Fees To Launched Token Buyback A: Spent buying the coin back from its pool and sending it to 0xdead.
SupplySideRevenue.Trading Fees To Launched Token Locked Li: Added to the coin's permanently locked pool position.

methodology.Fees: The fees players pay on settled positions: the open fee on each deposit and the 10% profit fee on a gain.
methodology.UserFees: The open fees and profit fees players pay on settled positions.
methodology.Revenue: The fees less the creator royalty: the protocol's share and the $OVER holders' share.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: The open fees and the profit fees less the creator royalty and the $OVER holders' share.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: 25% of the profit fees: from $OVER positions to the $OVER stakers' rewards, from USDG positions to $OVER buybacks.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The creator royalty: 15% of the profit fee on a winning prediction, paid to the creator of the channel predicted on.

Fees.Open Fees: The open fee on each position's deposit.
Fees.Profit Fees: 10% of the gain of a winning position or a close above the stake.

Revenue.Profit Fees To Protocol: The profit fees less the creator royalty and the $OVER holders' share.
Revenue.Profit Fees To $OVER Stakers: 25% of the profit fees from $OVER positions, to the $OVER stakers' rewards.
Revenue.Profit Fees To $OVER Buybacks: 25% of the profit fees from USDG positions, used to buy back $OVER.

ProtocolRevenue.Open Fees To Protocol: The open fees, kept by the protocol.
ProtocolRevenue.Profit Fees To Protocol: The profit fees less the creator royalty and the $OVER holders' share.

HoldersRevenue.Profit Fees To $OVER Stakers: 25% of the profit fees from $OVER positions, to the $OVER stakers' rewards.
HoldersRevenue.Profit Fees To $OVER Buybacks: 25% of the profit fees from USDG positions, used to buy back $OVER.

SupplySideRevenue.Profit Fees To Channel Creators: 15% of the profit fee on a winning prediction, to the creator of the channel predicted on.

methodology.Fees: Platform fees on every token and stock token trade made in Onagi: on Robinhood Chain paid in USDG into the Onagi fee vault, on Solana paid in USDC into the Onagi Solana fee account inside each Jupiter swap. Plus all Pons V2 swap fees and creator tax charged on ONAGI token trades (curve and graduated pool sweep events). Platform fees include a small reimbursement for network gas that Onagi pays on behalf of users, which is not separated on chain.

methodology.Revenue: Platform fees plus the creator share of ONAGI token swap fees that Pons credits to Onagi.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The Pons protocol and Pons buyback share of ONAGI token swap fees, not kept by Onagi.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: 75% of Robinhood Chain revenue: 50% is paid to eligible ONAGI holders in USDG and 25% buys ONAGI and sends it to the burn address. Computed from Onagi's published split.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: 25% of Robinhood Chain revenue goes to the Onagi treasury. Solana platform fees stay in Onagi's Solana fee account, outside the holder split, so all of them are protocol revenue.

HoldersRevenue.Holder Payouts: 50% of revenue, paid to eligible ONAGI holders in USDG.
HoldersRevenue.Token Buyback And Burn: 25% of revenue, used to buy ONAGI and burn it.

ProtocolRevenue.Treasury: 25% of Robinhood Chain revenue, kept by the Onagi treasury.
ProtocolRevenue.Solana Platform Fees To Treasury: All Solana platform fees, kept in the Onagi Solana fee account.

methodology.ProtocolRevenue: The platform fee on bonding-curve trades and the harvested locked-liquidity fees, all received by Grainpad.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The creator fee of each bonding-curve trade and of each graduated pool, paid to the wallet that launched the token.

Fees.Trading Fees: Platform fee plus creator fee on every LaunchLab bonding-curve trade of a Grainpad launch (1% under the current config), charged in the pool's quote token.
Fees.LP Fees: Quote-token fees harvested from the locked liquidity of graduated Grainpad launches.
Fees.Creator Fees: The quote-side creator fee of graduated Grainpad launches' Raydium CPMM pools, counted when the launch's creator claims it.

Revenue.Trading Fees To Protocol: The platform fee on bonding-curve trades, kept by Grainpad.
Revenue.LP Fees To Protocol: The harvested locked-liquidity fees, kept by Grainpad.

ProtocolRevenue.Trading Fees To Protocol: The platform fee on bonding-curve trades, received by Grainpad.
ProtocolRevenue.LP Fees To Protocol: The harvested locked-liquidity fees, received by Grainpad.

SupplySideRevenue.Graduated Pool Creator Fees To Creators: The creator fee of graduated pools, claimed by the wallet that launched the token.

methodology.UserFees: pump.fun creator fees paid by traders of coins launched through Furnace, split on-chain by the Furnace program.
methodology.Revenue: The Furnace treasury share and the $FURN buyback & burn share of the creator fees of coins launched through Furnace, plus the part of $FURN's own creator fees held by its vault, all of which buys back and burns $FURN.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: The 10% Furnace treasury share of each coin's creator fees, after the 30% of it paid to the coin's referrer when it has one.

methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Creator fees paid to the holders of each launched coin, spent on buying back and burning that coin, vested to its creator, or paid to its referrer.

Revenue.Creator Fees To FURN Buyback And Burn: Creator fees routed to $FURN buyback & burn: 10% of every coin's fees plus $FURN's own vault share.

HoldersRevenue.FURN Buyback And Burn: Creator fees that buy $FURN on its pump.fun curve or PumpSwap pool and burn it.

SupplySideRevenue.Creator Fees To Coin Creators: Share of each coin's creator fees vested to its creator.
SupplySideRevenue.Creator Fees To Referrers: 30% of the Furnace treasury share, paid to the referrer of a coin that has one.

HoldersRevenue.INJ Rewards To RUNNER Holders: RUNUP token fees swapped to INJ and distributed to RUNUP holders.

SupplySideRevenue.Trading Fees To Coin Holders: Community coin fees swapped to INJ and distributed to that coin's holders.
