SupplySideRevenue.Desk Pot: Launcher fee share and the $OTC creator fees left after the protocol's part, sent to the Desk pot and paid out to Desk NFT owners.
SupplySideRevenue.Desk Mint Surcharge: 0.45 SOL of each Desk NFT mint surcharge, sent to the Desk pot and paid out to Desk NFT owners.

methodology.Fees: The creator share of the Pons launchpad trading fee on GF trades, paid in USDG to the GongFu fee collector contract when it claims from the Pons fee escrow.
methodology.Revenue: All creator fees received by the GongFu fee collector. The contract has no owner and can only spend them on buying GF for the GongFu reward reserve.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Gets management + performance fees
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Generated yield excluding protocol fees
methodology.HoldersRevenue: USDG spent by the GongFu fee collector buying GF back into the GongFu reward reserve, which pays capped rewards to users who lock GF.

Fees.Creator Fees: Creator share of the Pons trading fee on GF trades, claimed in USDG by the GongFu fee collector.

Revenue.Creator Fees To Reserve Buybacks: Creator fees kept by the GongFu fee collector, which can only use them to buy GF into the reward reserve.

HoldersRevenue.Token Buy Back: USDG spent buying GF on the GF/USDG pool and delivering it into the GongFu reward reserve.

methodology.Fees: 1.50% of every FusedPad trade on the Meteora bonding curve, plus the quote-token LP fees FusedPad's locked liquidity earns after a coin graduates to Meteora DAMM v2. Covers holder distributions, the $FUSED burn pot, coin-creator fees, Meteora's protocol fee and referral fees. Identified by bonding-curve configs whose fee_claimer is the fused_fee Global PDA.
methodology.UserFees: The 1.50% a trader pays on every FusedPad bonding-curve trade, plus FusedPad's LP fees on graduated coins.
methodology.Revenue: The ~0.20% of every FusedPad trade used to buy and burn $FUSED (half becomes locked $FUSED liquidity once auto-LP is enabled), plus the 0.90% holder distribution on $FUSED's own pool, which goes to $FUSED holders. No treasury cut.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Zero. FusedPad does not keep a treasury cut; its share of trading fees goes to $FUSED holders through buy-and-burn and $FUSED holder distributions.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: The ~0.20% of every FusedPad trade used to buy and burn $FUSED (split into burn + permanently locked $FUSED liquidity once auto-LP is enabled), plus the 0.90% of every $FUSED trade paid out to $FUSED holders.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: 0.90% paid out to holders of each launched coin, coin creator fees (~0.096%), Meteora's ~0.30% protocol fee, and referral fees paid to hosting frontends.

Fees.Trading Fees: The 1.50% fee on every FusedPad bonding-curve trade, plus the quote-token LP fees FusedPad's locked liquidity earns on graduated coins' Meteora DAMM v2 pools.

Revenue.Token Buy Back: $FUSED buy-and-burn funded by FusedPad trading fees.
Revenue.Locked $FUSED Liquidity: Permanently locked $FUSED liquidity funded by FusedPad trading fees (zero until auto-LP is enabled).
Revenue.$FUSED Holder Distributions: 0.90% of every $FUSED trade on FusedPad, paid out to $FUSED holders in SOL.

HoldersRevenue.Token Buy Back: $FUSED buy-and-burn funded by FusedPad trading fees.
HoldersRevenue.Locked $FUSED Liquidity: Permanently locked $FUSED liquidity funded by FusedPad trading fees (zero until auto-LP is enabled).
HoldersRevenue.$FUSED Holder Distributions: 0.90% of every $FUSED trade on FusedPad, paid out to $FUSED holders in SOL.

SupplySideRevenue.Coin Holder Distributions: 0.90% of every trade in a launched coin, paid out to holders of that coin in the quote asset.
SupplySideRevenue.Creator Fees: Coin creator share: 8% of the bonding-curve trading fee (~0.096% of volume) and 8% of FusedPad's LP fees after graduation.
SupplySideRevenue.Protocol Fees to Meteora: Meteora's ~0.30% protocol share of every bonding-curve trade.
SupplySideRevenue.Referral Fees: Part of Meteora's protocol share handed back to whichever interface hosted the swap.

methodology.Fees: Everything paid into STANDARD: the ETH tax on every STANDARD/ETH swap and LP exit, charter auction prices in ETH, launchpad trade fees in the launch's pair asset plus the fixed launch fee, LP fees on the protocol's Uniswap v4 pools, license auction payments and charter exit fees paid in STANDARD, and S-Bills early-exit fees.
methodology.UserFees: Swap taxes, auction prices, launchpad trade fees, pool swap fees and exit fees are all paid by users.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The creator share of launchpad trade fees, the third-party LP share of fees on the protocol's pools, and informant bounties on charter revocations.
methodology.Revenue: Fees minus the supply side: the part of fees kept by the protocol and its token holders.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Revenue received by the protocol: ETH swap and LP-exit taxes and charter auction proceeds at the fee splitter, launchpad protocol fees and launch fees at the fee multisig, and the treasury's LP fee income. STANDARD fees that are retired or burned go to holders and are excluded, and ETH spent on STANDARD buybacks is deducted in the period the buyback executes, so heavy buyback days can be negative.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: ETH spent by PolBuyback and the ContractionVault buying STANDARD on the canonical pool, recognised when each buyback executes, plus STANDARD retired or burned out of fees: license auction payments, charter exit fees, the STANDARD side of the LP-exit tax and of the STANDARD/ETH pool fee, and S-Bills exit fees. S-Bills premiums distribute the bought-back STANDARD and are covered by the buyback line.

Fees.STANDARD/ETH Swap Tax: ETH tax charged by the TaxHook on every STANDARD/ETH swap (TaxCollected), 2% on buys and 3% on sells at steady state.
Fees.STANDARD/ETH LP Exit Tax: ETH and STANDARD tax charged by the TaxHook when non-protocol liquidity exits the STANDARD/ETH pool (LpTaxCollected).
Fees.Charter Auctions: ETH paid for charters in the daily charter auction (CharterPurchased).
Fees.Launchpad Fees To Protocol: Protocol share of launchpad trade fees, received by the fee multisig in the launch's pair asset.
Fees.Launchpad Fees To Creators: Creator share of launchpad trade fees credited in FeeEscrow.
Fees.Launch Fees: Fixed 0.0005 ETH fee per token launch, counted from Launched events.
Fees.Treasury LP Fees: Treasury Safe's share of swap fees on the protocol's v4 pools, from PoolManager Swap events.
Fees.Third-Party LP Fees: Third-party LPs' share of swap fees on the protocol's v4 pools.
Fees.License Auctions: STANDARD paid for branch licenses and retired from the ledger (LicensesPurchased).
Fees.Charter Exit Fees: STANDARD fee charged on charter withdrawals and revocations (Withdrawn, Revoked).
Fees.S-Bills Exit Fees: STANDARD fee charged on S-Bills early exits (Exited).

SupplySideRevenue.Launchpad Fees To Creators: Creator share of launchpad trade fees.
SupplySideRevenue.Third-Party LP Fees: Third-party LPs' share of pool swap fees.
SupplySideRevenue.Revocation Bounties: Bounty paid to the informant on a charter revocation.

Revenue.STANDARD/ETH Swap Tax: ETH swap tax, kept in full.
Revenue.Charter Auctions: Charter auction proceeds, kept in full.
Revenue.Launchpad Fees To Protocol: Protocol share of launchpad trade fees.
Revenue.Treasury LP Fees: Treasury's share of pool swap fees.
Revenue.Charter Exit Fees: Charter exit fees net of informant bounties.

ProtocolRevenue.STANDARD/ETH Swap Tax: ETH swap tax received by the fee splitter, minus the fee-splitter ETH spent on STANDARD buybacks in the period; the swap tax funds most of the splitter.
ProtocolRevenue.STANDARD/ETH LP Exit Tax: ETH side of the LP-exit tax, received by the fee splitter.
ProtocolRevenue.Charter Auctions: Charter auction ETH received by the fee splitter.
ProtocolRevenue.Launchpad Fees To Protocol: Launchpad protocol fees at the fee multisig.
ProtocolRevenue.Launch Fees: Launch fees at the fee multisig.
ProtocolRevenue.Treasury LP Fees: Treasury's LP fee income, excluding the STANDARD side of the STANDARD/ETH pool fee, which is burned.

HoldersRevenue.Token Buy Back: ETH spent by PolBuyback and the ContractionVault buying STANDARD on the canonical pool.
HoldersRevenue.STANDARD Retired From Fees: STANDARD burned by the protocol-owned liquidity: the STANDARD side of the LP-exit tax and the STANDARD side of the 1% STANDARD/ETH pool fee.
HoldersRevenue.License Auctions: STANDARD paid for licenses and retired from supply.
HoldersRevenue.Charter Exit Fees: Charter exit fees in STANDARD, half recycled to remaining charters and half retired.
HoldersRevenue.S-Bills Exit Fees: S-Bills exit fees in STANDARD, half burned and half paid to remaining bills.

methodology.Fees: Scrooge's fee, taken by ScroogeRouter from each swap's output (the fee field of Swapped and SwappedMany), plus the fee a site embedding Scrooge's swap widget charges on top through ScroogePartner (at most 1%). On swaps through Relay, Scrooge's app fee as Relay reports it paid to Scrooge's fee wallet: on swaps under Scrooge's referrer "scrooge.exchange" since 2026-10-29, and before then, when Scrooge's swaps carried no referrer, on the ones Relay filled for Scrooge's app, listed by id. On Solana, the SOL the swap paid Scrooge's fee wallet or its wrapped-SOL account. Fees of the underlying venues and pools are not included. Scrooge takes no fee on swaps through LI.FI.
methodology.Revenue: Scrooge's fee on each swap: taken by ScroogeRouter on Robinhood Chain, paid as Relay's app fee on swaps through Relay, and paid in SOL to Scrooge's Solana fee wallet on Solana. The fee a partner site adds goes to that site and is not included.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Scrooge's fee on swaps through Relay, paid as Relay's app fee, and on Solana, paid in SOL to Scrooge's Solana fee wallet: kept by Scrooge, not burned.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The fee a partner site charges in Scrooge's swap widget, paid to that site.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Scrooge's fee on swaps through ScroogeRouter on Robinhood Chain, which the fee wallet swaps into SCROOGE every 15 minutes and burns, counted when the fee is charged. Burns funded by Scrooge's launchpad fees, which reach the same wallet, are not included.

Fees.Swap Fees: Scrooge's fee on each swap, taken from the output by ScroogeRouter, paid through Relay as an app fee, or paid in SOL on Solana.
Fees.Partner Fees: The fee a site embedding Scrooge's swap widget adds on top, taken from the output by ScroogePartner.

Revenue.Swap Fees To Scrooge: Scrooge's swap fee on swaps through Relay and on Solana, kept by Scrooge.
Revenue.Token Buy Back: Scrooge's swap fee on ScroogeRouter swaps, spent buying SCROOGE to burn.

ProtocolRevenue.Swap Fees To Scrooge: Scrooge's swap fee on swaps through Relay and on Solana, kept by Scrooge.

SupplySideRevenue.Partner Fees To Integrating Sites: Partner fees, paid to the sites that embed Scrooge's swap widget.

HoldersRevenue.Token Buy Back: Scrooge's swap fee on ScroogeRouter swaps, which the fee wallet swaps into SCROOGE and burns (sends to 0x…dEaD).

methodology.Volume: Notional volume of Hyperliquid perpetual trades (including HIP-3 markets) placed through Blackboard, counted from its builder code.
methodology.Fees: Hyperliquid builder code fees paid by users on perpetual trades placed through Blackboard; excludes Hyperliquid's own trading fees.
methodology.Revenue: Builder code fees received by Blackboard, before any referral or partner rebates.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Builder code fees received by Blackboard, before any referral or partner rebates.

Fees.Hyperliquid Builder Code Fees: Builder code fees paid by users on Hyperliquid trades.

Revenue.Hyperliquid Builder Code Fees: Builder code fees collected by the builder.

ProtocolRevenue.Hyperliquid Builder Code Fees: Builder code fees collected by the builder.

methodology.Fees: Builder fees received by Blackboard from trades on Polymarket v2
methodology.Revenue: Builder fees received by Blackboard from trades on Polymarket v2
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Builder fees received by Blackboard from trades on Polymarket v2

Fees.Polymarket Builder Fees: Builder fees received by Blackboard from trades on Polymarket v2

Revenue.Polymarket Builder Fees: Builder fees received by Blackboard from trades on Polymarket v2

ProtocolRevenue.Polymarket Builder Fees: Builder fees received by Blackboard from trades on Polymarket v2

methodology.Volume: Volume of Lighter trades of every market type (perps, spot and Up or Down prediction markets) routed through Infinex's Lighter partner account: notional for perps and spot, cash paid for prediction markets.
methodology.Fees: Partner fees earned by Infinex on Lighter trades of every market type (perps, spot and Up or Down prediction markets) routed through its integration.
methodology.Revenue: Partner fees earned by Infinex on Lighter trades of every market type (perps, spot and Up or Down prediction markets) routed through its integration.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Partner fees earned by Infinex on Lighter trades of every market type (perps, spot and Up or Down prediction markets) routed through its integration.

Fees.Lighter Partner Fees: Partner fees earned by Infinex on Lighter trades of every market type (perps, spot and Up or Down prediction markets) routed through its integration.

Revenue.Lighter Partner Fees: Partner fees earned by Infinex on Lighter trades of every market type (perps, spot and Up or Down prediction markets) routed through its integration.

ProtocolRevenue.Lighter Partner Fees: Partner fees earned by Infinex on Lighter trades of every market type (perps, spot and Up or Down prediction markets) routed through its integration.

methodology.Fees: Swap fees paid by traders, at the fee each swap was charged: the override fee the pool plugin logs with the swap, or the pool fee when no override is set.
methodology.Revenue: The community fee share of swap fees, read per pool on-chain (20% on every initialized pool today), minus Algebra's cut taken by the community vault.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: The community fee share of swap fees after Algebra's cut, which accrues in the Camelot V4 community vault for the fee receiver set there.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Money going to governance token holders
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Swap fees kept by liquidity providers, plus Algebra's licensing cut of the community fee (10% of it today).
methodology.Volume: Value swapped across the Camelot V4 (Algebra Integral) pools created by the Camelot V4 factory on Arbitrum, counting one side of each trade. Pools launched through third-party custom deployers are not included.

Fees.Token Swap Fees: Every swap fee charged, at the rate the trade actually paid.

SupplySideRevenue.LP Fees: The part of swap fees that stays in the pool for liquidity providers.
SupplySideRevenue.Swap Fees To Algebra: Algebra's licensing cut, taken by the community vault from the fees pools send it.

Revenue.Swap Fees To Protocol: Community fees, after Algebra's cut, accruing in the Camelot V4 community vault.

ProtocolRevenue.Swap Fees To Protocol: Community fees, after Algebra's cut, accruing in the Camelot V4 community vault.

methodology.Fees: USDG received by the H081 protocol treasury's fee-only USDG account: the 0.20% relay fee on relayed withdrawals and spends (sent out of the bank vault by the stipend_pool program) plus the 0.25% loan origination fee on funded loans (sent by the lender in stream_loan::fund). The treasury's USDG account receives nothing else from the protocol; transfers from or signed by the team's wallets (deployer, config authority, treasury multisig and its members, relayer hot wallet) are excluded. H081 token trading and creator fees are not protocol fees and are not counted (the H081 mint is excluded).
methodology.Revenue: USDG received by the H081 protocol treasury's fee-only USDG account: the 0.20% relay fee on relayed withdrawals and spends (sent out of the bank vault by the stipend_pool program) plus the 0.25% loan origination fee on funded loans (sent by the lender in stream_loan::fund). The treasury's USDG account receives nothing else from the protocol; transfers from or signed by the team's wallets (deployer, config authority, treasury multisig and its members, relayer hot wallet) are excluded. H081 token trading and creator fees are not protocol fees and are not counted (the H081 mint is excluded).
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: USDG received by the H081 protocol treasury's fee-only USDG account: the 0.20% relay fee on relayed withdrawals and spends (sent out of the bank vault by the stipend_pool program) plus the 0.25% loan origination fee on funded loans (sent by the lender in stream_loan::fund). The treasury's USDG account receives nothing else from the protocol; transfers from or signed by the team's wallets (deployer, config authority, treasury multisig and its members, relayer hot wallet) are excluded. H081 token trading and creator fees are not protocol fees and are not counted (the H081 mint is excluded).
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Interest paid to lenders

Fees.Protocol Fees: 0.20% relay fee on relayed withdrawals / spends and 0.25% loan origination fee, both paid in USDG to the treasury's fee-only USDG account.

Revenue.Protocol Fees: 100% of the relay and origination fees, kept by the protocol treasury.

ProtocolRevenue.Protocol Fees: 100% of the relay and origination fees, kept by the protocol treasury.

methodology.Fees: Actual trading fees recorded on confirmed Stryke RFQ fills; excludes settlement charges, external venue fees and sunsetted products.
methodology.Revenue: All trading fees recorded on confirmed RFQ fills, before subsequent token-holder allocation. Uses answer.fee for later deployments and paired FillPriced.fee for the October 4 deployment. No fee-recipient allowlist is enforced; legacy confirmation events do not expose a recipient. Excludes maker premiums, settlement deductions and external venue fees.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: 20% of recorded RFQ trading fees from October 30, 2026, following the published protocol allocation. Earlier allocation is unknown and omitted. The 80% token-holder allocation is not counted until rewards are paid on-chain.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Fees going to governance token holders
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: LPs revenue
methodology.NotionalVolume: Underlying notional recorded for each confirmed Stryke RFQ option purchase or sale, counted once on the chain where the fill is confirmed.
methodology.PremiumVolume: Actual premium or sale proceeds recorded for confirmed Stryke RFQ options fills, excluding protocol fees and refunded requests.

Fees.Options Trading Fees: The actual fee in each FillConfirmed answer; no fixed fee-rate estimate is used.

Revenue.RFQ Collected Trading Fees: All recorded fill fees: answer.fee on later deployments, or paired FillPriced.fee on the October 4 deployment. This is not a recipient-filtered treasury-transfer measure.

ProtocolRevenue.Options Trading Fees To Protocol: 20% retained protocol allocation of recorded RFQ trading fees from October 30, 2026; excludes the 80% holder allocation.

methodology.Fees: Total Quotrons V1 and V2 hook swap fees plus NFT royalties paid directly through Seaport or released by the royalty splitter on Robinhood Chain, excluding direct royalties from mixed-collection orders, marketplace fees and subsequent redistribution of the same funds.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Hook fee allocations to LP reinvestment, STONKBROKER burns and the creator, plus the creator portion of NFT royalties, recorded at accrual or royalty receipt/release; allocations precede any later treasury recovery.
methodology.Revenue: Hook fees allocated to terminal rewards and the keeper portion of NFT royalties, before conversion and distribution to terminals; later treasury recoveries are excluded.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: V2 trading and royalty rewards recognized on allocation at actual USDG conversion cost, with USDG valued at $1. V1 allocated stocks and PAXG use historical token prices. Unallocated pots, queued conversion funds, migration credits and subsequent claims are excluded.

Fees.Swap Fees: Actual V1 and V2 hook fee totals in floor stocks or WETH, including FeeTaken events emitted by recovery swaps; recovered principal and flash-loan transfers are excluded.
Fees.NFT Royalties: Direct royalties on Quotrons-only Seaport orders and royalty splitter releases in their payment currencies; ERC-20 splitter royalties are recognized when released.

SupplySideRevenue.Swap Fees To LPs: Actual toLp amounts allocated by the V1 and V2 hooks to LP reinvestment, recorded at the swap.
SupplySideRevenue.Swap Fees To Creators: Actual toCreator amounts allocated by the V1 and V2 hooks to the creator, recorded at the swap.
SupplySideRevenue.Swap Fees Allocated To STONKBROKER Burns: Actual toBurn amounts earmarked by the V1 and V2 hooks for the separate STONKBROKER token; the immutable V2 allocation continues after the advisory vote and periodic recoveries.
SupplySideRevenue.NFT Royalties To Creator: Direct NFT royalty payments to the creator and creatorAmount from the dedicated splitter's release events.

Revenue.Swap Fees For Terminal Rewards: Hook fee totals less toLp, toCreator and toBurn, retained for terminal reward conversion and distribution.
Revenue.NFT Royalties To Keeper: Direct NFT royalty payments to the keeper and splitter totals less creatorAmount, retained for the royalty reward pipeline.

HoldersRevenue.Trading Rewards Accrued To Terminal Hold: V2 FloorConverted.usdgOut measures USDG spent acquiring stocks allocated to holders, at $1 per USDG. V1 stock notifications exclude gold and unallocated floor shares, adding first-holder pot releases; PAXG counts only when deposited. V1 stocks retain historical token pricing. Migration credits and claims are excluded.
HoldersRevenue.Royalty Rewards Accrued To Terminal Hold: Royalty FloorConverted.usdgIn measures USDG spent acquiring stocks allocated to holders, at $1 per USDG, reconciled to reward notifications. Keeper receipts, queued funds and subsequent claims are excluded.

methodology.Fees: Total yields from deposited assets in all curated vaults.
methodology.Revenue: Yields are collected by curators.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Yields are collected by curators.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Yields are distributed to vaults depositors/investors.

Fees.Assets Yields: Interest yields generated from deposited assets in all curated vaults, including both curator fees and depositor yields
Fees.Morpho Yields: Interest yields generated from deposited assets in Morpho
Fees.Morpho Management Fees: Management fees charged on assets deposited in Morpho vaults
Fees.Euler Yields: Interest yields generated from deposited assets in Euler
Fees.Kamino Yields: Interest yields generated from deposited assets in Kamino kvaults
Fees.Kamino Management Fees: Management fees charged on assets deposited in Kamino kvaults
Fees.Aave V4 Yields: Borrow interest paid on curated Aave V4 hubs

Revenue.Assets Yields: Portion of interest yields retained by vault curators as management and performance fees
Revenue.Morpho Performance Fees: Performance fees charged from vaults in Morpho
Revenue.Morpho Management Fees: Management fees charged from vaults in Morpho
Revenue.Euler Performance Fees: Performance fees charged from vaults in Euler
Revenue.Kamino Performance Fees: Performance fees charged from Kamino kvaults
Revenue.Kamino Management Fees: Management fees charged from Kamino kvaults
Revenue.Aave V4 Hub Fees: Curator share of the liquidity fee charged on curated Aave V4 hubs

SupplySideRevenue.Assets Yields: Portion of interest yields distributed to vault depositors/investors after curator fees are deducted
SupplySideRevenue.Morpho Yields Distributed To Supliers: Interest yields generated from deposited assets in Morpho distributed to suppliers
SupplySideRevenue.Euler Yields Distributed To Supliers: Interest yields generated from deposited assets in Euler distributed to suppliers
SupplySideRevenue.Kamino Yields Distributed To Supliers: Interest yields from Kamino kvaults distributed to suppliers
SupplySideRevenue.Aave V4 Yields Distributed To Suppliers: Borrow interest on curated Aave V4 hubs distributed to suppliers after the liquidity fee
SupplySideRevenue.Aave V4 Hub Fees To Aave DAO: Aave DAO share of the liquidity fee charged on curated Aave V4 hubs

methodology.Fees: Trading fees paid by traders on bonding curves and on graduated pools: a 1% protocol fee plus a creator fee of 0, 0.25 or 0.5%. On Solana, graduated pool fees are the ALPHA share of the Meteora DAMM v2 pool fee, counted when claimed, and the fee on a creator's first buy inside the launch transaction is not counted because no event reports it.
methodology.UserFees: Trading fees paid by traders on bonding curves and on graduated pools.
methodology.Revenue: The 1% protocol fee taken on every trade.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The creator fee of 0, 0.25 or 0.5% paid to the token creator on every trade.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Half of the 1% protocol fee, booked for operations.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: The other half of the protocol fee, counted when it is released on chain to the executor that buys back and burns ALPHA. Amounts booked for the buyback but not yet released are not counted. Not tracked on Solana.

Fees.Bonding Curve Trading Fees: Protocol and creator fees paid on bonding curve trades.
Fees.Graduated Pool Trading Fees: Protocol and creator fees charged by the ALPHA hook on graduated Uniswap v4 pools, and the ALPHA share of Meteora DAMM v2 pool fees on Solana.

UserFees.Bonding Curve Trading Fees: Protocol and creator fees paid on bonding curve trades.
UserFees.Graduated Pool Trading Fees: Protocol and creator fees charged by the ALPHA hook on graduated Uniswap v4 pools, and the ALPHA share of Meteora DAMM v2 pool fees on Solana.

Revenue.Bonding Curve Trading Fees To Protocol: The 1% protocol fee on bonding curve trades.
Revenue.Graduated Pool Trading Fees To Protocol: The 1% protocol fee on graduated pool trades.

SupplySideRevenue.Bonding Curve Trading Fees To Creators: The creator fee on bonding curve trades.
SupplySideRevenue.Graduated Pool Trading Fees To Creators: The creator fee on graduated pool trades.

ProtocolRevenue.Protocol Fees To Operations: Half of the 1% protocol fee, booked for operations.

HoldersRevenue.Protocol Fees Released To ALPHA Buyback: Protocol fees released on chain to the executor that buys back and burns ALPHA.

methodology.Volume: Trading in Book tokens on TOKENIZE.FUN (a Book is a token backed by one trader's vault): buys and sells on each Book's launch curve, tax included. Swaps in the Uniswap v3 or v4 pool a Book moves to once it bonds are excluded. Only Books priced in WETH or STONKBROKER are counted.
methodology.Fees: Paid by Book traders and holders: the anti-snipe tax on launch-curve buys and sells (it decays after a Book launches), the swap fee in each Book's locked Uniswap pool, and a 2% fee on a Book's closing value when its epoch ends and the vault is liquidated.
methodology.Revenue: The StonkBrokers protocol's share of fees: 8.33% of the anti-snipe tax (16.67% on Books not priced in WETH, which have no StockBooster share) and half of the 2% close fee.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: 8.33% of the anti-snipe tax (16.67% on Books not priced in WETH) and half of the 2% close fee, paid to the StonkBrokers treasury.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Fees paid out to others: 75% of the anti-snipe tax into the Book's vault for its holders, 8.33% to the Book's creator, 8.34% on WETH Books to StockBooster dividends for activated StonkBrokers, all swap fees from the locked pools to Book LP stakers and the vault, and half of the 2% close fee to Mancer, which hosts Books.

Fees.Book Anti Snipe Tax: Anti-snipe tax on launch-curve buys and sells, which decays after a Book launches. 75% goes to the Book's vault, 8.33% to the creator, 8.33% to the treasury and 8.34% to StockBooster (to the treasury on Books not priced in WETH).
Fees.Book Locked Pool LP Fees: Swap fee on trades in each Book's locked Uniswap v3 or v4 pool, measured on the WETH or STONKBROKER side.
Fees.Book Close Fee: 2% of the Book's closing value when its epoch ends and the vault is liquidated, split evenly between the StonkBrokers treasury and Mancer, which hosts Books.

Revenue.Book Anti Snipe Tax To Protocol: 8.33% of the anti-snipe tax (16.67% on Books not priced in WETH), kept by the protocol.
Revenue.Book Close Fee To Protocol: Half of the 2% close fee, kept by the protocol.

ProtocolRevenue.Book Anti Snipe Tax To Protocol: 8.33% of the anti-snipe tax (16.67% on Books not priced in WETH), paid to the StonkBrokers treasury.
ProtocolRevenue.Book Close Fee To Protocol: Half of the 2% close fee, paid to the StonkBrokers treasury.

SupplySideRevenue.Book Anti Snipe Tax To Book Vault: 75% of the anti-snipe tax, paid into the Book's vault for its holders.
SupplySideRevenue.Book Anti Snipe Tax To Creator: 8.33% of the anti-snipe tax, paid to the Book's creator.
SupplySideRevenue.Book Anti Snipe Tax To StockBooster: 8.34% of the anti-snipe tax on WETH Books, paid to StockBooster dividends for activated StonkBrokers.
SupplySideRevenue.Book Locked Pool LP Fees: All swap fees from the locked Book pools, paid to Book LP stakers and the Book vault's own LP position.
SupplySideRevenue.Book Close Fee To Mancer: Half of the 2% close fee, paid to Mancer, which hosts Books.

methodology.Volume: Bonding curve price of every Clutch TV pass bought or sold, plus the gross amount of every tip (net to the streamer plus the protocol fee).
methodology.Fees: 2.5% protocol fee on pass trades and tips, plus the streamer royalty paid on every pass trade.
methodology.Revenue: The 2.5% protocol fee on pass trades and tips, collected by the ClutchFeeRouter.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: 40% of the protocol fee, sent to the StonkBrokers treasury.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: 60% of the protocol fee, used to buy back and burn STONKBROKER.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Royalties paid to streamers on pass trades. Tips themselves go to streamers and are counted as volume, not fees.

Fees.Pass Trade Protocol Fee: 2.5% protocol fee charged on every pass buy and sell.
Fees.Pass Trade Streamer Royalty: Streamer royalty charged on every pass buy and sell (set per channel, max 10%).

methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Builder-code fees received by the Pump.fun builder account, before any subsequent referral or callout reward payouts.

SupplySideRevenue.Assets Yields: Yield streamed to sUSDv and sETHv stakers, measured as the growth in value of their shares.

ProtocolRevenue.Instant Unstake Fees: 0.1% instant-unstake fee sent to the Vesper treasury.

methodology.ProtocolRevenue: All of enterprise verification fees, kept by Jupiter. Not used for JUP buybacks.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Retail verification fees, paid in JUP to a burn account and burned in batches.

methodology.ProtocolRevenue: All of rent reclaim fees, kept by Jupiter. Not used for JUP buybacks.

methodology.Fees: Paid by players: 1% of all BNB deployed each round, 10% of the BNB on tiles not drawn, AutoMiner fees, and the 10% processing fee on mined MING when it is claimed.
methodology.UserFees: All fees are paid by players: the 1% deploy fee, the round fee on tiles not drawn, AutoMiner fees and the processing fee.
methodology.Revenue: Player fees kept by the protocol: everything except the Goldpot's 10% of the round fee and the processing fee, which go to players.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: 10% of the round fee, which buys gold (XAUt) paid to players through the Goldpot, and the processing fee, paid to players holding unprocessed MING.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: The 1% deploy fee and AutoMiner fees, kept by the protocol.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: 90% of the round fee, which the Treasury spends on MING buybacks and burns, and gold for MING stakers.

Fees.Deploy Fees: 1% of all BNB deployed each round.
Fees.Round Fees: 10% of the BNB on tiles not drawn, after the deploy fee (all of it when no one is on the drawn tile).
Fees.AutoMiner Fees: Fee paid each round by players who let the AutoMiner deploy for them.
Fees.Processing Fees: 10% of mined MING, taken when a player claims it. Valued in BNB at the MING/WBNB PancakeSwap price.

Revenue.Deploy Fees To Protocol: The 1% deploy fee, kept by the protocol.
Revenue.Round Fees To Treasury: 90% of the round fee, sent to the Treasury for MING buybacks and gold for stakers.
Revenue.AutoMiner Fees To Protocol: AutoMiner fees, kept by the protocol.

SupplySideRevenue.Round Fees To Goldpot: 10% of the round fee, which buys gold paid to players through the Goldpot.
SupplySideRevenue.Processing Fees To Players: The processing fee, shared at once among the players holding unprocessed MING.

ProtocolRevenue.Deploy Fees To Protocol: The 1% deploy fee, sent to the protocol after topping up the BNB that pays for round triggers.
ProtocolRevenue.AutoMiner Fees To Protocol: AutoMiner fees, sent to the protocol after topping up the BNB that pays for AutoMiner triggers.

HoldersRevenue.Token Buy Back: BNB the Treasury sets aside to buy MING on PancakeSwap. All MING bought is burned.
HoldersRevenue.Gold To MING Stakers: 1.11% of the Treasury's share, set aside to buy gold (XAUt) for MING stakers.

methodology.Volume: USDC staked by real players in rounds with money on them; the table's own house players and Roulana's own wallets are left out.
methodology.Fees: Gross gaming revenue: what real players staked minus what they were paid.
methodology.Revenue: The table's 1% fee on every stake, paid by the bank out of its edge.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The gross gaming revenue less the fee, which stays with the bank's investors.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Half of the fee: the service fee to Roulana.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Half of the fee: it funds the public buyback of $ROULANA (half burned, half to the daily prizes).

Fees.Gross Gaming Revenue: Real players' stakes minus their payouts.

Revenue.Service Fee To Treasury: Half of the 1% fee, to Roulana.
Revenue.Buyback Fee To Token Holders: Half of the 1% fee, to the $ROULANA buyback.

SupplySideRevenue.Gross Gaming Revenue To Bank Investors: Gross gaming revenue less the fee, kept by the bank's investors.

ProtocolRevenue.Service Fee To Treasury: Half of the 1% fee, to Roulana.

HoldersRevenue.Buyback Fee To Token Holders: Half of the 1% fee, to the $ROULANA buyback.

methodology.UserFees: 3% of the premium paid by option buyers and 0.1% of the strike paid by option holders when they exercise, in WETH.
methodology.Fees: 3% of the premium when an option offer fills and 0.1% of the strike when an option is exercised, paid in WETH. Premiums received by option writers are not fees and are excluded.
methodology.Revenue: All option premium and exercise fees, collected by the Kyte FeeVault and split between KYTE stakers, KYTE buy-and-burn and the ops wallet.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: 50% of option premium and exercise fees, sent to the Kyte ops wallet.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: 50% of option premium and exercise fees: 30% paid to KYTE stakers in WETH and 20% sent to the KYTE buy-and-burn contract.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: LPs revenue

Fees.Option Exercise Fees: 0.1% of the strike on every option exercise.

UserFees.Option Exercise Fees: 0.1% of the strike, paid by the option holder on exercise.

Revenue.Fees To Ops: 50% of option premium and exercise fees, sent to the Kyte ops wallet.

HoldersRevenue.Fees To KYTE Stakers: 30% of option premium and exercise fees, paid to KYTE stakers in WETH.
HoldersRevenue.Token Buy Back: 20% of option premium and exercise fees, sent to the KYTE buy-and-burn contract.

ProtocolRevenue.Fees To Ops: 50% of option premium and exercise fees, sent to the Kyte ops wallet.

methodology.Volume: Value of all trades in Ascend launch pools, including sells filled by the launchpad's standing bids, measured in the pool's pair asset (USDC, HYPE or KNTQ) before the trading fee.
methodology.Fees: Trading fees charged by the Ascend launchpad on every launch-pool trade, counted when they are settled to each coin's creator escrow (normally within an hour of the trade).
methodology.UserFees: Trading fees paid by traders on every Ascend launch-pool trade.
methodology.Revenue: The part of trading fees sent to the Ascend protocol splitter, plus the part used by the launchpad's standing bids to buy launched coins into protocol treasuries.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The part of trading fees paid to coin creators (including the share held in escrow until a coin graduates), to builders who brought the launch, and to buybacks of the launched coin.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: The protocol splitter's team, strategic KNTQ, stakers and strategic HYPE legs, plus standing-bid buys of launched coins into protocol treasuries. The stakers leg is held in a protocol treasury while staking is not live.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: The 28.8% of the protocol splitter's share set aside to burn KNTQ.

Fees.Swap Fees: Dynamic hook fee charged in the pair asset on every launch-pool trade, from the gross amount of each escrow Settled event.

UserFees.Swap Fees: Dynamic hook fee paid by traders on every launch-pool trade.

Revenue.Swap Fees To Standing Bids: Share of fees funding the launchpad's standing bids, which buy launched coins into the Ascend cohort and inventory treasuries.
Revenue.Swap Fees To Team Treasury: 10% of the protocol splitter's share, sent to the team treasury.
Revenue.Swap Fees To KNTQ Burn: 28.8% of the protocol splitter's share, sent to the KNTQ burn treasury.
Revenue.Swap Fees To Strategic KNTQ: 43.2% of the protocol splitter's share, sent to the ecosystem allocator for strategic KNTQ.
Revenue.Swap Fees To Stakers Leg: 9% of the protocol splitter's share reserved for stakers, held in a protocol treasury while staking is not live.
Revenue.Swap Fees To Strategic HYPE: 9% of the protocol splitter's share, sent to the protocol-owned HYPE treasury.

ProtocolRevenue.Swap Fees To Standing Bids: Share of fees funding the launchpad's standing bids, which buy launched coins into the Ascend cohort and inventory treasuries.
ProtocolRevenue.Swap Fees To Team Treasury: 10% of the protocol splitter's share, sent to the team treasury.
ProtocolRevenue.Swap Fees To Strategic KNTQ: 43.2% of the protocol splitter's share, sent to the ecosystem allocator for strategic KNTQ.
ProtocolRevenue.Swap Fees To Stakers Leg: 9% of the protocol splitter's share reserved for stakers, held in a protocol treasury while staking is not live.
ProtocolRevenue.Swap Fees To Strategic HYPE: 9% of the protocol splitter's share, sent to the protocol-owned HYPE treasury.

HoldersRevenue.Swap Fees To KNTQ Burn: 28.8% of the protocol splitter's share, sent to the KNTQ burn treasury.

SupplySideRevenue.Swap Fees To Creators: Share of fees credited to the coin's creator (or its Holder Rewards / Buyback seat).
SupplySideRevenue.Swap Fees Held For Creators: Creator share held in the escrow before a coin graduates; released to the creator on graduation or forfeited if the coin misses its deadline.
SupplySideRevenue.Swap Fees To Builders: Builder fee paid to the partner that brought the launch.
SupplySideRevenue.Swap Fees To Coin Buybacks: Share of fees set aside to buy back the launched coin.

methodology.Fees: Trading fees earned by liquidity positions opened through Homer (counted when collected), Homer Swap's routing fee on every trade it routes, and the Homer pool hook's fee on swaps in pools created on Homer.
methodology.UserFees: Fees paid by traders: the pool trading fees earned by positions opened through Homer, Homer Swap's routing fee and the Homer pool hook's fee.
methodology.Revenue: Homer's cut of the trading fees collected by positions opened through Homer (14% as of November 2026, capped at 25% by the contracts) plus all Homer Swap and pool hook fees, all sent to Homer's fee router.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: The part of Homer's revenue that goes to the team: the share of HYPE fees not paid to $HOMER stakers (40% as of November 2026) and all fees paid in other tokens.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: The share of Homer's HYPE and wrapped HYPE revenue that the fee router streams to $HOMER stakers (60% as of November 2026); fees in other tokens go only to the team.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The trading fees collected by positions opened through Homer that stay with the liquidity providers who own them (86% as of November 2026).

Fees.LP Fees: Trading fees earned by liquidity positions opened through Homer on Elysium DEXs (Uniswap v4, KleosSwap, ElysPump and others), counted when the owner collects them, including both the liquidity provider's part and Homer's cut.
Fees.Homer Swap fees: Homer Swap's routing fee, 0.25% of the HYPE side of every trade it routes as of November 2026; the pool fees on those trades go to the pools' own liquidity providers and are not counted.
Fees.Homer pool hook fees: The fee the Homer pool hook takes on every swap in pools created on Homer.

Revenue.LP Fees: Homer's cut of the collected LP fees (14% as of November 2026), sent to Homer's fee router.
Revenue.Homer Swap fees: All Homer Swap routing fees, sent to Homer's fee router.
Revenue.Homer pool hook fees: All Homer pool hook fees, sent to Homer's fee router.

SupplySideRevenue.LP Fees: The rest of the collected LP fees (86% as of November 2026), kept by the liquidity providers who own the positions.

HoldersRevenue.LP Fees: The $HOMER stakers' share (60% as of November 2026) of Homer's cut of LP fees, when that cut is paid in HYPE or wrapped HYPE.
HoldersRevenue.Homer Swap fees: The $HOMER stakers' share (60% as of November 2026) of Homer Swap fees, which are always paid in HYPE.
HoldersRevenue.Homer pool hook fees: The $HOMER stakers' share (60% as of November 2026) of Homer pool hook fees, when they are paid in HYPE or wrapped HYPE.

ProtocolRevenue.LP Fees: The team's part of Homer's cut of LP fees: the remaining 40% when paid in HYPE, and all of it when paid in other tokens.
ProtocolRevenue.Homer Swap fees: The team's part of Homer Swap fees, the remaining 40% as of November 2026.
ProtocolRevenue.Homer pool hook fees: The team's part of Homer pool hook fees: the remaining 40% when paid in HYPE, and all of it when paid in other tokens.

methodology.Fees: Swap fees paid by traders in Kalos DEX pools, at the pool fee tier.

methodology.Volume: Volume of trades on LoopUP bonding curves, in the quote asset. Trades in graduated Uniswap V4 pools are not included, they are counted under Uniswap V4.
methodology.Fees: Launch fees, the 1% swap fee on bonding-curve trades and graduated Uniswap V4 pool trades (including the short decaying anti-snipe tax at launch), and any optional creator tax, all paid by traders and launchers.

UserFees.Creator Tax: Optional creator tax paid by traders.

Revenue.Creator Tax To LOOP Buyback And Burn: Creator tax of tokens whose creator fee recipient is the $LOOP burn wallet.

SupplySideRevenue.Swap Fees To Memecoin Buyback And Lock: Part of the creator share used to buy back and lock the traded memecoin when a creator enables it (0% on all current launches).
SupplySideRevenue.Creator Tax To Token Creators: Creator tax, paid in full to the token's creator fee recipient.

ProtocolRevenue.Launch Fees To Treasury: Launch fees sent to the LoopUP treasury leg of the LoopFeeSplitter.

HoldersRevenue.Swap Fees To LOOP Buyback And Burn: 20% of the swap fee used to buy back and burn $LOOP, plus the creator share of $LOOP itself, whose creator fee recipient is the burn wallet.
HoldersRevenue.Creator Tax To LOOP Buyback And Burn: Creator tax of tokens whose creator fee recipient is the $LOOP burn wallet.

methodology.HoldersRevenue: The share of the protocol fee vault used to buy back and burn MONTRA: 70% since 2026-11-10, none before.

UserFees.Launch Fees: Native launch fee paid by token launchers.

HoldersRevenue.Launch Fees To MONTRA Buyback And Burn: MONTRA buyback lane of the protocol fee vault (70% of the vault since 2026-11-10); the MONTRA bought is burned, from launch fees.

methodology.ProtocolRevenue: The protocol's share of performance and management fees. The program's protocol fee rate is currently 0.

Fees.Management Fees: Annual fee on vault assets, accrued over time, in USD as reported by the feeAccrued event.

SupplySideRevenue.Instant Exit Fees To Depositors: Instant exit fees kept in the vault for its remaining depositors, since the 10 November 2026 program upgrade.
SupplySideRevenue.Queued Exit Fees To Depositors: Queued exit fees kept in the vault for its remaining depositors, since the 10 November 2026 program upgrade.
SupplySideRevenue.Performance Fees To Curators: Performance fees paid to the vault's curator.
SupplySideRevenue.Management Fees To Curators: Management fees paid to the vault's curator.

methodology.Fees: Fees paid by traders on swaps in Helios DLMM and DAMM pools (each pool's LP fee, which the Helios hook sets per swap, plus Helios' protocol fee of 0.1% of the swap until 2026-11-11 and 0.25% since), and since 2026-11-09 the creator fee Helios earns on trades of $HELIOS in the token's pool on Boxa.
methodology.Revenue: Helios' protocol fee on every swap (0.1% until 2026-11-11, 0.25% since) in its DLMM and DAMM pools, taken by the fee hook, and since 2026-11-09 the creator fee Helios earns on trades of $HELIOS in the token's pool on Boxa.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Helios' protocol fee on every swap (0.1% until 2026-11-11, 0.25% since) in its DLMM and DAMM pools, taken by the fee hook for the Helios treasury, and the treasury's 45% of the creator fee Helios earns on trades of $HELIOS in the token's pool on Boxa.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: HYPE that Helios pays to $HELIOS stakers and HYPE that Helios spends buying $HELIOS back from the market to burn it, since the token's relaunch on 2026-11-09. Both are paid out of the creator fee Helios earns on trades of $HELIOS in the token's pool on Boxa (half of it for buybacks, 5% for stakers), and are counted when they are paid.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The LP fee of every swap in Helios DLMM and DAMM pools, which stays in the pool for its liquidity providers.
methodology.Volume: Swap volume in Helios DLMM and DAMM pools (the Uniswap v4 pools that carry the Helios fee hook), counted once per trade as what the trader paid in, on the HYPE or stablecoin side of the pool.

Fees.Token Swap Fees: The LP fee of each swap in a Helios DLMM or DAMM pool, at the rate the hook set for that swap (carried in the Uniswap v4 Swap event).
Fees.Protocol Swap Fees: Helios' protocol fee on each swap (0.1% until 2026-11-11, 0.25% since) in a Helios DLMM or DAMM pool, from the hook's ProtocolFeeTaken events.
Fees.HELIOS Creator Fees: The token creator's part of each swap fee in the $HELIOS pool on Boxa, which Helios receives as the token's creator, from the Boxa hook's FeeTaken events. Boxa's own part of that fee is not counted.

SupplySideRevenue.Swap Fees To LPs: All LP fees, which stay in the pools for their liquidity providers.

Revenue.Protocol Swap Fees To Treasury: All of Helios' protocol fee (0.1% of each swap until 2026-11-11, 0.25% since), held by the hook for the Helios treasury.
Revenue.HELIOS Creator Fees To Helios: All of the creator fee from the $HELIOS pool on Boxa. Helios uses half to buy $HELIOS back and burn it, keeps 45% in the treasury and pays 5% to $HELIOS stakers.

ProtocolRevenue.Protocol Swap Fees To Treasury: All of Helios' protocol fee (0.1% of each swap until 2026-11-11, 0.25% since), held by the hook for the Helios treasury.
ProtocolRevenue.HELIOS Creator Fees To Treasury: The treasury's 45% of the creator fee from the $HELIOS pool on Boxa: the half not used for buybacks, less the tenth of it paid to stakers.

HoldersRevenue.HYPE Paid To HELIOS Stakers: Native HYPE sent to the HeliosStaking contract for $HELIOS stakers, counted when it is added (RewardAdded).
HoldersRevenue.Token Buy Back: Native HYPE the Helios buyback wallet spent buying $HELIOS through KyberSwap's router, counted when each purchase is made. The $HELIOS bought is burned afterwards.

methodology.UserFees: Opening and time fees paid by borrowers on HedgeHood StockLend loans of tokenized stocks.
methodology.Fees: Fees borrowers pay to borrow tokenized stocks on HedgeHood StockLend: an opening fee when a loan is taken and a time fee when it is repaid. Excludes flash-loan fees (paid in the stock token), bonuses paid to liquidators, and the time fee settled inside a liquidation or buy-in, which the contract does not record.
methodology.Revenue: HedgeHood's share of the opening and time fees borrowers pay, set per market (10% on every market as of November 2026).
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: HedgeHood's share of the opening and time fees borrowers pay (10% on every market as of November 2026), collected by the HedgeHood treasury.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The rest of the opening and time fees borrowers pay (90% on every market as of November 2026), streamed to the lenders who supplied the stock.

Fees.Loan Opening Fees: Charged when a loan opens; it grows with how far the stock token trades above its oracle price on the DEX pool, and is zero when there is no such premium.
Fees.Loan Time Fees: Charged at repayment: an annual rate on the borrowed amount for the time the loan was open (5% a year while the stock market is open and 20% while it is closed, as of November 2026).

UserFees.Loan Opening Fees: Opening fees borrowers pay when a loan opens.
UserFees.Loan Time Fees: Time fees borrowers pay at repayment for the time the loan was open.

Revenue.Loan Opening Fees To Protocol: HedgeHood's share of loan opening fees.
Revenue.Loan Time Fees To Protocol: HedgeHood's share of loan time fees.

ProtocolRevenue.Loan Opening Fees To Protocol: HedgeHood's share of loan opening fees, collected by the treasury.
ProtocolRevenue.Loan Time Fees To Protocol: HedgeHood's share of loan time fees, collected by the treasury.

SupplySideRevenue.Loan Opening Fees To Lenders: Lenders' share of loan opening fees.
SupplySideRevenue.Loan Time Fees To Lenders: Lenders' share of loan time fees.

methodology.UserFees: The trading fee traders pay on each fill's premium (0.05% of the premium, paid by the taker), plus the price improvement kept when two crossing orders are matched.
methodology.Fees: The trading fee on each fill's premium (0.05% of the premium, paid by the taker), plus the price improvement kept when two crossing orders are matched. It is credited to the protocol's fee recipient inside the market at the fill (PremiumSettled.fee). The market makers' spread and the options' settlement payouts are not fees.
methodology.Revenue: All trading fees on option premiums go to the protocol (the FeeSweeper forwards them to the HedgeHood options Safe).
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: All trading fees on option premiums go to the protocol (the FeeSweeper forwards them to the HedgeHood options Safe).
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Fees going to governance token holders
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: LPs revenue
methodology.NotionalVolume: The shares of the underlying stock in each fill (Traded.quantity), valued at the stock token price. Every fill is counted once, whether a taker filled a signed order or two orders were matched.
methodology.PremiumVolume: What the buyer pays in USDG for each fill (PremiumSettled.sellerGets + fee).

Fees.Trading fees on option premiums: PremiumSettled.fee of every fill on the seven markets, in USDG.

UserFees.Trading fees on option premiums: PremiumSettled.fee of every fill on the seven markets, in USDG.

Revenue.Trading fees on option premiums: PremiumSettled.fee of every fill, credited to the protocol fee recipient.

ProtocolRevenue.Trading fees on option premiums: PremiumSettled.fee of every fill, credited to the protocol fee recipient.

methodology.Fees: A 2% fee on trader profit when a winning BTC or ETH position closes, plus a 2% fee on the trader's loss or forfeited margin that the protocol-owned pool wins on losing closes and liquidations (charged only while the payout queue is empty). There are no opening, closing or funding fees, and trader losses kept by the pool are not counted as fees.
methodology.Revenue: The part of trading and liquidation fees paid out to the developer and to SPAPER stakers.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Half of each paid-out trading and liquidation fee, sent to the developer. 20% of this share is later used off-chain to buy back and burn SOLON, which is not tracked separately.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Half of each paid-out trading and liquidation fee, distributed to SPAPER stakers.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Fees on winning trades that are not paid out to the developer or stakers and stay in the protocol-owned pool that takes the other side of every trade.

Fees.Trading Fees: 2% of the profit on winning closes, and 2% of the trader's loss on losing closes collected by the pool.
Fees.Liquidation Fees: 2% of the margin forfeited to the pool in cash-funded liquidations.

Revenue.Fees To Dev: Half of each paid-out fee, sent to the developer.
Revenue.Fees To SPAPER Stakers: Half of each paid-out fee, distributed to SPAPER stakers.

ProtocolRevenue.Fees To Dev: Half of each paid-out fee, sent to the developer.

HoldersRevenue.Fees To SPAPER Stakers: Half of each paid-out fee, distributed to SPAPER stakers.

SupplySideRevenue.Fees Retained In LP: Winning-close fees that are not paid out and stay in the protocol-owned pool.

methodology.Fees: Fees paid by Parchment traders: open fees (0 since launch), close fees on notional, win fees on profit, long-hold fees added to the win fee on positions held past a free period (since 2026-11-15), loss fees on margin lost, liquidation bounties, the flat execution fee per filled order and optional builder fees, net of the discount referred traders get back on close and win fees. The house pool's own trading profit is not counted.
methodology.Revenue: Open, close, win, long-hold and loss fees kept by Parchment after referral shares, split on chain between the house pool, stakers and the treasury: since 2026-11-13, 80% to the house pool, 10% to stakers and 10% to the treasury; before that, 30% to 70% to stakers by house pool coverage and the rest to the treasury.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: House pool and treasury shares of the open, close, win, long-hold and loss fees Parchment keeps. The house pool is Parchment's own trading capital, with no outside depositors (house pool share since 2026-11-13). Later surplus sweeps out of the pool are not counted again.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Share of the open, close, win, long-hold and loss fees Parchment keeps that is paid in USDC to PARCHMENT stakers.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Execution fees reimbursing the order keeper's gas, referral fees paid to referrers, builder fees paid to builders and liquidation bounties paid to liquidators.

Fees.Open Fees: Open fee charged on position notional at open (market taker fee, 0 since launch).
Fees.Close Fees: Close fee on position notional, charged on every close, net of any referee discount.
Fees.Win Fees: Win fee on adjusted profit on winning closes paid out at once, net of any referee discount.
Fees.Long-Hold Fees: Long-hold fee added to the win fee on winning closes of positions held past the free period, paid out at once, net of any referee discount.
Fees.Queued Win Fees: Win and long-hold fees, and the part of the close fee taken out of profit, on winning closes whose profit was queued; counted when the queued claim is paid out, net of any referee discount.
Fees.Loss Fees: Loss fee on the margin a trader loses on a losing close or a liquidation, a protocol cut taken before the rest goes to the house pool.
Fees.Execution Fees: Flat execution fee per filled two-step order, refunded when the order is not filled.
Fees.Builder Fees: On-top fee on profit for orders placed through a builder code.
Fees.Liquidation Bounties: Bounty paid to the liquidator out of a liquidated position's margin.

Revenue.Trading Fees To House Pool: Share of retained fees added to the cash of the house pool, Parchment's own trading capital.
Revenue.Trading Fees To Stakers: Share of retained fees paid in USDC to stakers.
Revenue.Trading Fees To Treasury: Share of retained fees kept by the Parchment treasury.

ProtocolRevenue.Trading Fees To House Pool: Share of retained fees added to the cash of the house pool, Parchment's own trading capital.
ProtocolRevenue.Trading Fees To Treasury: Share of retained fees kept by the Parchment treasury.

HoldersRevenue.Trading Fees To Stakers: Share of retained fees paid in USDC to stakers.

SupplySideRevenue.Execution Fees To Keeper: Execution fees paid to the order keeper, which pays the gas of order fills.
SupplySideRevenue.Referral Fees To Referrers: Part of the fee paid to the trader's referrer and second-level referrer.
SupplySideRevenue.Builder Fees To Builders: Builder on-top fees paid to the builder.
SupplySideRevenue.Liquidation Bounties To Liquidators: Liquidation bounties paid to the liquidator.

methodology.UserFees: Interest paid by SwanUSD borrowers who opt out of redemptions, PSM mint fees and the redemption fees redeemers pay to borrowers. Excludes the sUSDS yield on the PSM reserves, which is paid by Sky rather than by SwanUSD users, and liquidation incentives paid to liquidators.
methodology.Fees: Interest paid by SwanUSD borrowers who opt out of redemptions, sUSDS yield earned on the USDS reserves of the SwanUSD PSM, PSM mint fees and the redemption fees redeemers pay to borrowers. Excludes liquidation incentives paid to liquidators and SWAN emissions.
methodology.Revenue: Swan DAO's share of borrow interest (the market's local reserve fee, 50% since launch, plus any interest above what sSwanUSD stakers can receive), all sUSDS yield on the PSM reserves and all PSM mint fees.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Swan DAO revenue sent to the DAO treasury instead of SWAN stakers, 0% of it since launch.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Borrow interest paid to sSwanUSD stakers, the Monolith protocol fee on borrow interest (0% so far), and redemption fees kept by the borrowers whose collateral is redeemed.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Swan DAO revenue distributed to SWAN stakers (sSWAN) by the RevenueRouter, 100% of it since launch.

Fees.Borrow Interest: Interest paid by SwanUSD borrowers who opt out of redemptions (paid debt).
Fees.PSM sUSDS Yield: Yield earned by the PSM USDS reserves deposited in sUSDS.
Fees.PSM Mint Fees: Fee on minting SwanUSD with USDS through the PSM, ramping from 0% to 1% over the second half of the immutability period (from 2028-10-22).
Fees.Redemption Fees: Fee paid by redeemers when they swap SwanUSD for the collateral of redeemable borrowers (1.75% since launch).

UserFees.Borrow Interest: Interest paid by SwanUSD borrowers who opt out of redemptions (paid debt).
UserFees.PSM Mint Fees: Fee paid by users minting SwanUSD with USDS through the PSM, ramping from 0% to 1% over the second half of the immutability period (from 2028-10-22).
UserFees.Redemption Fees: Fee paid by redeemers when they swap SwanUSD for the collateral of redeemable borrowers (1.75% since launch).

SupplySideRevenue.Borrow Interest To sSwanUSD Stakers: Borrow interest after the market and Monolith fees, paid to sSwanUSD stakers.
SupplySideRevenue.Borrow Interest To Monolith: Monolith protocol fee on borrow interest, set by the Monolith factory (0% so far, 10% max).
SupplySideRevenue.Redemption Fees To Borrowers: Redemption fees kept as collateral by the redeemed borrowers.

Revenue.Borrow Interest To Swan DAO: Local reserve fee on borrow interest (50% since launch), plus any interest above what sSwanUSD stakers can receive.
Revenue.PSM sUSDS Yield To Swan DAO: All sUSDS yield on the PSM reserves.

HoldersRevenue.Swan DAO Revenue To SWAN Stakers: Share of Swan DAO revenue distributed to SWAN stakers (sSWAN), 100% since launch.

ProtocolRevenue.Swan DAO Revenue To Treasury: Share of Swan DAO revenue sent to the DAO treasury, 0% since launch.

methodology.Fees: The buy / sell tax each coin's creator set (1-10%), paid in the pool's pair asset on every trade of a coin launched on Kleos with a tax. Classic coins' trading fees are in KleosSwap's listing.
methodology.UserFees: The buy / sell taxes traders pay on coins launched on Kleos with a tax.
methodology.Revenue: The platform's cut of every tax: kept by the platform, or burned for a pair asset whose platform cut burns, such as $KLEOS.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: The platform's cut of taxes, kept by the platform.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: The platform's cut of taxes on $KLEOS-paired coins, which is burned.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The rest of each tax: to the coin's creator, its holders (rewards) and its buyback & burn.

Fees.Swap Taxes: Buy / sell tax on taxed coins, from the hooks' Taxed events.

UserFees.Swap Taxes: Buy / sell tax paid by traders.

Revenue.Fees To Platform: The platform's share of taxes (platformBps, stamped per coin), kept.
Revenue.Platform Cut Burned ($KLEOS): The platform's share of taxes on $KLEOS-paired coins, burned.

ProtocolRevenue.Fees To Platform: The platform's share of taxes, kept by the platform.

HoldersRevenue.Platform Cut Burned ($KLEOS): The platform's share of taxes on $KLEOS-paired coins, burned.

SupplySideRevenue.Fees To Coin Buyback And Burn: Set aside to buy back and burn the coin.

methodology.Fees: wstO taken from every swap in wstO/launch-token pairs and burned, valued as the O it redeems for in that chain's vault.
methodology.Revenue: No swap burn fees are retained as protocol revenue; all accrue to vault stakers.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: No swap fees go to the o1.exchange treasury.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: All wstO swap burn fees accrue to vault stakers through a higher O redemption value per remaining wstO share.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: No swap burn fees are classified as governance-token holder revenue; vault staker income is supply-side revenue.

Fees.wstO Swap Burn Fees: wstO burned by the wstO launch hook on buys and sells (1% buy/sell defaults, frozen per pool at creation from the factory defaults), valued in O at the period's closing share rate of that chain's vault.

SupplySideRevenue.wstO Swap Burn Fees To Stakers: The O backing burned wstO stays in the vault and benefits all remaining vault stakers through the share redemption rate.

methodology.Volume: Value of trades on the eleos bonding curve before a coin moves to its pool, in HYPE and before the 1% curve fee. Trading in the coins' pools after launch is not counted as volume.
methodology.Fees: Buy and sell taxes paid by traders on every eleos coin trade (set per coin at launch, up to 10% each way, including the anti-snipe extra on early buys), plus the 1% fee on bonding-curve trades.
methodology.UserFees: Buy and sell taxes and bonding-curve fees paid by traders on eleos coins.
methodology.Revenue: The platform's 20% of every tax and all bonding-curve fees, plus everything the tax on EOS (eleos's own coin) pays to the team, to EOS holders, to EOS buyback-and-burn and into the locked EOS pool.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: The platform's 20% of every tax and all bonding-curve fees, sent to the eleos platform wallet, plus the team's share of the EOS tax and the share of it locked into the EOS pool.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: The part of the tax on EOS (eleos's own coin) paid to EOS holders as HYPE dividends or used to buy back and burn EOS.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The 80% of every coin's tax that goes, as the coin's creator chose, to the creator, to HYPE dividends for the coin's holders, to buyback-and-burn of the coin and to the coin's locked liquidity (EOS excluded).

Fees.Trading Taxes: The coin's buy/sell tax on every taxed trade in an eleos pool, paid in the pool's pair asset, from the hooks' Taxed events.
Fees.Anti-Snipe Taxes: Extra tax on buys right after launch (starting at 50% and falling to the coin's tax over the anti-snipe window).
Fees.Bonding Curve Fees: 1% fee on every buy and sell on the eleos bonding curve.

UserFees.Trading Taxes: The coin's buy/sell tax paid by traders on every taxed trade in an eleos pool.
UserFees.Anti-Snipe Taxes: Extra anti-snipe tax paid on buys right after launch.
UserFees.Bonding Curve Fees: 1% fee paid by traders on the eleos bonding curve.

Revenue.Trading Taxes To Platform: 20% of every coin tax, kept by the eleos platform.
Revenue.Anti-Snipe Taxes To Platform: 20% of every anti-snipe extra, kept by the eleos platform.
Revenue.Bonding Curve Fees To Platform: All bonding-curve fees, kept by the eleos platform.
Revenue.EOS Taxes To Team: The creator share of the EOS tax, paid to the eleos team wallet.
Revenue.EOS Taxes To EOS Locked Liquidity: The liquidity share of the EOS tax, added to the EOS pool and locked there for good.
Revenue.EOS Taxes To EOS Holders: The holders share of the EOS tax, paid to EOS holders as HYPE dividends.
Revenue.EOS Taxes To EOS Buyback And Burn: The buyback share of the EOS tax, used to buy back and burn EOS.

ProtocolRevenue.Trading Taxes To Platform: 20% of every coin tax, paid to the eleos platform wallet.
ProtocolRevenue.Anti-Snipe Taxes To Platform: 20% of every anti-snipe extra, paid to the eleos platform wallet.
ProtocolRevenue.Bonding Curve Fees To Platform: All bonding-curve fees, paid to the eleos platform wallet.
ProtocolRevenue.EOS Taxes To Team: The creator share of the EOS tax, paid to the eleos team wallet.
ProtocolRevenue.EOS Taxes To EOS Locked Liquidity: The liquidity share of the EOS tax, added to the EOS pool and locked there for good.

HoldersRevenue.EOS Taxes To EOS Holders: The holders share of the EOS tax, paid to EOS holders as HYPE dividends.
HoldersRevenue.EOS Taxes To EOS Buyback And Burn: The buyback share of the EOS tax, used to buy back and burn EOS.

SupplySideRevenue.Trading Taxes To Coin Creators: The creator share of a coin's tax, paid to its creator (for Stocks coins, to the StocksVault that buys the coin's stock token).
SupplySideRevenue.Trading Taxes To Coin Holders: The holders share of a coin's tax, paid to the coin's holders as dividends.
SupplySideRevenue.Trading Taxes To Coin Buyback And Burn: The buyback share of a coin's tax, used to buy back and burn the coin.
SupplySideRevenue.Trading Taxes To Coin Locked Liquidity: The liquidity share of a coin's tax, added to the coin's pool and locked there for good.
SupplySideRevenue.Anti-Snipe Taxes To Coin Buyback And Bur: The 80% of anti-snipe extras left after the platform share, used to buy back and burn the coin.

methodology.Fees: Swap fees of 1-5%, fixed by each coin's creator at launch, paid by traders on every trade in a Volta launch pool. They are counted in the pool's pair asset (HYPE, KNTQ, VOLTA or USDC) when the hook distributes them; fees taken in the launched coin count once the hook has sold them for the pair asset. The optional anti-snipe premium, taken in the launched coin and burned, is not counted, and pools paired with unpriced assets are not valued.
methodology.UserFees: Swap fees paid by traders on every trade in a Volta launch pool, counted when the hook distributes them in the pair asset.
methodology.Revenue: The protocol's 30% of every swap fee in Volta launch pools, plus the 70% creator share of the VOLTA pool's own fees, which Volta set entirely to VOLTA buyback and burn.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: The 20% of the protocol's 30% share of Volta swap fees that stays in the Volta owner wallet.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: VOLTA bought back and burned: 80% of the protocol's 30% share of every Volta swap fee, plus the 70% creator share of the VOLTA pool's own fees.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The 70% of every swap fee in launched coins' pools that goes to the creator side, split as each creator chose at launch between the creator, buyback and burn of the coin, and pair-asset rewards to the coin's holders.

Fees.Swap Fees: Hook swap fee (1-5%) paid on every launch-pool trade, from the hook's PoolFeesDistributed events in the pair asset.

UserFees.Swap Fees: Hook swap fee paid by traders on every launch-pool trade.

Revenue.Swap Fees To VOLTA Buyback And Burn: 80% of the protocol's 30% share of every swap fee, used by the Volta owner wallet to buy back and burn VOLTA (VOLTA fees are burned directly), plus the 70% creator share of the VOLTA pool's own fees, spent by the FeeExecutor on VOLTA buyback and burn.
Revenue.Swap Fees To Treasury: 20% of the protocol's 30% share of every swap fee, kept by the Volta owner wallet.

ProtocolRevenue.Swap Fees To Treasury: 20% of the protocol's 30% share of every swap fee, kept by the Volta owner wallet.

HoldersRevenue.Swap Fees To VOLTA Buyback And Burn: 80% of the protocol's 30% share of every swap fee, used by the Volta owner wallet to buy back and burn VOLTA (VOLTA fees are burned directly), plus the 70% creator share of the VOLTA pool's own fees, spent by the FeeExecutor on VOLTA buyback and burn.

SupplySideRevenue.Swap Fees To Creators: Part of the 70% creator side paid to the holder of the coin's creator NFT, as set by the creator at launch.
SupplySideRevenue.Swap Fees To Coin Buyback And Burn: Part of the 70% creator side used to buy back and burn the coin, as set by the creator at launch.
SupplySideRevenue.Swap Fees To Coin Holder Rewards: Part of the 70% creator side paid in the pair asset to the coin's holders, as set by the creator at launch.

methodology.Volume: Volume of every trade routed through AgoraRouter (its Swapped events), counted on the HYPE side of the trade.
methodology.Fees: Agora's fee on each trade, taken by AgoraRouter in HYPE or the traded token (the fee field of Swapped). Fees of the underlying pools are not included.
methodology.Revenue: Agora's fees less the share booked to referrers (a referral cost, claimable by referrers from AgoraRouter).
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Agora's fees less the share booked to referrers (a referral cost, claimable by referrers from AgoraRouter).
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The share of each fee booked to the trader's referrer, claimable from AgoraRouter.

Fees.Token Swap Fees: Agora's fee on each trade routed through AgoraRouter.

Revenue.Swap fees to Agora: Agora's fees less the referrer share.

ProtocolRevenue.Swap fees to Agora: Agora's fees less the referrer share.

SupplySideRevenue.Referral fees: The referrer's share of each fee, claimable from AgoraRouter.

methodology.UserFees: Swap fees paid by traders in nest's Uniswap v4 pools on Elysium.
methodology.Fees: Swap fees paid by traders in nest's Uniswap v4 pools on Elysium.
methodology.Revenue: nest's 10% levy on the swap fees earned by liquidity providers, taken by nest's hook when fees are collected.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: nest's 10% levy on liquidity providers' swap fees, sent to nest's levy recipient wallet.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Money going to governance token holders
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The 90% of swap fees kept by liquidity providers after nest's levy.
methodology.Volume: Value of every swap in nest's Uniswap v4 pools on Elysium.

Fees.Swap Fees: Swap fees paid by traders on every swap.

UserFees.Swap Fees: Swap fees paid by traders on every swap.

Revenue.Swap Fees To Protocol: 10% of swap fees, levied by nest's hook on the fees liquidity providers collect.

ProtocolRevenue.Swap Fees To Protocol: 10% of swap fees, sent to nest's levy recipient wallet.

SupplySideRevenue.Swap Fees To LPs: 90% of swap fees, kept by liquidity providers.

methodology.UserFees: The 1% pool fee traders pay on every trade.
methodology.Fees: KleosSwap's 1% pool fee, paid by traders on every trade.
methodology.Revenue: Kleos's part of the pool fees earned by the locked launch positions of coins launched on Kleos, and its 10% of the LP fees other providers collect through Kleos's liquidity page (HYPE side).
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Kleos's part of the launch positions' pool fees and its 10% of LP fees collected through Kleos's page, kept by the platform.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Money going to governance token holders
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Pool fees to each launched coin's creator, its buyback & burn and the Road to Core fund, the coin side of launch positions' fees (burned), and the LP fees other liquidity providers earn, less Kleos's 10% of what they collect through its page.
methodology.Volume: Value of every trade on KleosSwap, on its HYPE leg and before the 1% pool fee.

Fees.KleosSwap LP Fees: KleosSwap's 1% pool fee on every trade.

UserFees.KleosSwap LP Fees: KleosSwap pool fee paid by traders.

Revenue.Fees To Platform: The platform's share of launch positions' HYPE-side pool fees.
Revenue.Kleos Share Of LP Fees Collected: 10% of the LP fees other providers collect through Kleos's liquidity page (HYPE side), paid to the platform in the collect.

ProtocolRevenue.Fees To Platform: The platform's share of launch positions' HYPE-side pool fees, kept by the platform.
ProtocolRevenue.Kleos Share Of LP Fees Collected: 10% of the LP fees collected through Kleos's liquidity page (HYPE side).

SupplySideRevenue.Fees To Creators: The coin creator's share of its launch position's HYPE-side fees.
SupplySideRevenue.Fees To Coin Buyback And Burn: Part of the creator's share set aside to buy back and burn the coin.
SupplySideRevenue.Fees To Road To Core Fund: Road to Core share of launch positions' HYPE-side fees (coreBpsOf).
SupplySideRevenue.Coin-Side LP Fees Burned: Launch positions' fees paid in the coin, burned by the launchpad.

methodology.Fees: Transaction fees paid by users for executing transactions on the Cosmos network, including the tip paid to the block proposer
methodology.Revenue: Transaction fees not paid to validators: before Gaia v18 the community tax share sent to the community pool, since v18 (July 2024) the base fee locked in the feemarket-fee-collector module account
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Before Gaia v18 (July 2024) the community tax share of transaction fees went to the community pool: 2% until December 19, 2022, 10% after (prop 88). Since v18 fees no longer pass through the community tax
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Since Gaia v18 (July 2024) the base fee of every tx, and since v19.1 (August 2024) the whole fee of failed txs, is locked in the feemarket-fee-collector module account (distribute_fees = false), a soft burn that takes it out of circulation without reducing total supply
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Before Gaia v18 transaction fees minus the community tax went to validators and delegators, since v18 only the tip above the base fee goes to the block proposer

Fees.Transaction Fees: Transaction fees paid by users for executing transactions on the Cosmos network, including the tip paid to the block proposer

Revenue.Transaction Fees To Community Pool: Community tax share of transaction fees before Gaia v18 (block 21330500), sent to the community pool: 2% until prop 88 (block 13315659), 10% after
Revenue.Base Fees Locked In Feemarket Module: Since Gaia v18, fees received by the feemarket-fee-collector module account minus the tips it pays out: the base fee (base gas price x gas consumed) of successful txs, plus the whole fee of failed txs since v19.1

ProtocolRevenue.Transaction Fees To Community Pool: Community tax share of transaction fees before Gaia v18 (block 21330500), sent to the community pool: 2% until prop 88 (block 13315659), 10% after

HoldersRevenue.Base Fees Locked In Feemarket Module: Since Gaia v18, the base fee of successful txs plus the whole fee of failed txs since v19.1, locked in the feemarket-fee-collector module account, which no tx can move funds out of (soft burn)

SupplySideRevenue.Transaction Fees To Validators: Transaction fees before Gaia v18 (block 21330500) minus the community tax, distributed to validators and delegators
SupplySideRevenue.Tips To Block Proposers: Tip (fee minus base fee) paid to the block proposer since Gaia v18, from tip_pay events

methodology.Fees: Gas fees paid in HYPE for transactions on Elysium, base fee and priority fee, plus the small parent-chain data fee charged before the 2026-11-09 launch and briefly on launch day.
methodology.Revenue: 75% of Elysium gas fees: the 50% Kinetiq allocates to KNTQ buybacks and the 25% it keeps for protocol operations.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: 25% of Elysium gas fees, which Kinetiq shares with the builders whose apps drive blockspace demand.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: 50% of Elysium gas fees, which Kinetiq allocates to buying KNTQ on the open market; the bought KNTQ is sent to the Hyperliquid Assistance Fund.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: 25% of Elysium gas fees, kept by Kinetiq for protocol operations.

Fees.Transaction Gas Fees: Gas fees paid by Elysium users, measured as the growth of the accounts ArbOS credits fees to (network and infra fee accounts, the parent-chain data fee pool and the batch poster's fee collector).

Revenue.Gas Fees To KNTQ Buybacks: 50% of gas fees, allocated to open-market KNTQ buybacks.
Revenue.Gas Fees To Protocol Operations: 25% of gas fees, kept for protocol operations.

SupplySideRevenue.Gas Fees To Builders: 25% of gas fees, shared with builders whose apps drive blockspace demand.

HoldersRevenue.Token Buy Back: 50% of gas fees, used to buy KNTQ on the open market and sent to the Hyperliquid Assistance Fund.

ProtocolRevenue.Gas Fees To Protocol Operations: 25% of gas fees, kept by Kinetiq for protocol operations.

methodology.UserFees: Users pay $0 for transactions. sFUEL (gas token) is obtained free from faucets and has no market value.
methodology.Fees: SKALE uses sFUEL (SKALE Fuel), a gas token distributed FREE via faucets. While transactions consume gas on-chain, sFUEL has $0 monetary value. User fees are $0.
methodology.Revenue: Network revenue comes from SKL token staking subscriptions by dApp developers, not from transaction fees. On-chain transaction fees are $0 as sFUEL is free.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Protocol revenue is generated through SKL staking model where dApp developers stake tokens for network access. Transaction fees contribute $0 as sFUEL is valueless.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Validators/nodes are compensated through SKL staking rewards, not transaction fees. On-chain gas fees in sFUEL are $0.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: No sFUEL is burned or distributed as revenue since it has no value. Revenue model is entirely based on SKL token staking.
